jobs.title: Asset/Move Coordinator I (Relocation Project Coordinator)
jobs.description:
At Avsar Construction Development, Inc., we are passionate about delivering high-quality, sustainable construction solutions that create a positive impact on both communities and the environment. Guided by the belief that safe and reliable shelter is a fundamental human need, we approach every project with a focus on innovation, responsibility, and long-term value.

While we are a growing company, our foundation is built on the extensive experience and expertise of seasoned construction professionals. Their diverse industry backgrounds and hands-on knowledge help us deliver the quality, service, and reliability clients expect, while maintaining the flexibility and forward-thinking mindset of a growing organization. As we continue to grow, we remain committed to raising the standard of excellence in construction and building a better future for the communities we serve.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an **Asset & Move Coordinator I (Relocation Project Coordinator)** to support furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FF&E) coordination, procurement, and relocation activities across multiple educational facilities and construction projects.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Support furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FF&E) selection, specification, procurement, purchasing, and installation activities.
* Coordinate furniture and equipment requirements for new construction, renovation, and temporary swing-space projects.
* Assist with developing furniture and equipment inventories and identifying additional items required for project completion.
* Support procurement activities, including vendor coordination, bid reviews, purchasing, and tracking of orders.
* Monitor FF&E and relocation budgets, schedules, deliveries, and installation progress.
* Coordinate with project managers, architects, interior designers, facility representatives, vendors, and end users to plan furniture layouts and relocation activities.
* Assist in preparing scopes of work for movers and specialty contractors when required.
* Coordinate furniture and equipment deliveries, onsite installations, pre-move preparations, and post-move activities.
* Provide on-site oversight during relocation and installation activities to ensure work is completed according to project requirements.
* Assist with punch-list inspections, issue resolution, and final closeout activities.
* Coordinate asset tagging, inventory tracking, and disposition requirements.
* Maintain accurate project documentation, including purchase orders, proposals, delivery records, invoices, shipping documents, and related correspondence.
* Ensure assigned areas are properly prepared, accessible, and secured during relocation and installation activities.

### **Requirements**

**Required Experience**

* At least **1 year** of relevant experience in **interior design, construction, engineering, facilities management, furniture and equipment coordination, procurement, or relocation/move management**.

**Required Skills**

* Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings and furniture layouts.
* Knowledge of furniture and equipment specifications and procurement processes.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Office** applications, including **Word** and **Excel**.
* Ability to work on-site at multiple project locations.

**Required Education**

* High school diploma.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Bachelor's degree** in **Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design, Construction Management, Project Management, Facilities Management, or a related field**.
* Experience in procurement, sourcing, purchasing, or asset management.
* Previous experience working on public works or institutional construction projects.
* Knowledge/proficiency in **AutoCAD**.
* Relevant professional certifications or memberships, such as **CID, IIDA, AIA, IFMA**, or **LEED**.

### **What We Offer**

Finding the right workplace can make all the difference. That's why fostering a positive team environment, encouraging professional growth, and recognizing the value of every employee remain a priority as the company continues to grow.

**401(k) Retirement Plan**

Invest in your future with a retirement savings plan designed to help you achieve your long-term financial goals.

**Comprehensive Health Benefits**

Access medical, dental, and vision coverage to support your health and well-being, both on and off the job.

**Paid Time Off (PTO)**

Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and enjoy life outside of work with generous paid time off.

**Professional Growth Opportunities**

Expand your skills, gain valuable industry experience, and advance your career through meaningful project involvement and continuous learning.

**A Supportive Team Environment**

Work alongside experienced professionals who value collaboration, encourage new ideas, and recognize your contributions.

**Join Us**

If you're looking for an opportunity to make an impact, grow your career, and be part of a team that is building a better future, we'd love to hear from you. We look forward to welcoming talented and passionate individuals to the Avsar Construction team.

**Application Process & What to Expect**

Thank you for your interest in Avsar Construction Development! We're glad you're considering joining our team.

Please submit **one application per position** through the official LinkedIn or Lever application link. To help us keep the process organized and ensure every application receives proper consideration, materials sent directly to employees by email, text, or social media will not be reviewed unless requested by HR.

**What to Expect**

* **Application Review –** We’ll review your application and experience.

* **Getting to Know You –** Selected candidates will be invited for a phone screening.

* **Interviews –** Candidates moving forward will have the opportunity to meet with our team.

A **friendly, outgoing, and open personality is extremely important**. You will regularly communicate with customers, vendors, employees, contractors, property managers, tenants, and other professionals, so we are looking for someone who is naturally pleasant, confident, and comfortable dealing with people.

**Responsibilities will include:**

* Communicate with contractors, property managers, tenants, attorneys, lenders, and vendors
* Track deadlines, documents, payments, renewals, repairs, and ongoing projects
* Research vendors, properties, products, pricing, and other business matters as needed

**The ideal candidate is someone who:**

jobs.title: Operations & Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Operations & Events Coordinator**

**Los Angeles, CA | Part-Time**

**About the Role**

This is a varied, hands-on position for someone who enjoys staying busy, solving practical problems, and seeing their work make a difference.

You might spend one day preparing event materials and organizing supplies, another picking up items around Los Angeles, and another helping set up technology or supporting an event on-site.

**You’ll have established tools, checklists, and direction to work from. We need someone who can use those tools consistently, manage their own assignments, and move work forward without needing constant reminders.** You don't need to design new systems or manage entire events independently. You do need to take responsibility for your part, communicate clearly, and follow through.

The workload varies throughout the year, with lighter periods between events and busier periods when an event is approaching. This makes the role a good fit for someone seeking part-time work with flexibility, variety, and opportunities to contribute.

**What You'll Do**  
**Event Preparation & On-Site Support**

* Prepare event materials, including name tags, signage, check-in sheets, printed documents, and activity supplies.
* Manage a high volume of printing, including handouts, postcards, signage, and other event materials, and check that everything is printed correctly and ready on time.
* Gather, organize, transport, and keep track of supplies and equipment needed for events.
* When teammates propose an idea or add content to an event, anticipate the materials, supplies, and setup it will need, and flag what has to be ordered, made, or picked up so everything is ready in time.
* Handle local errands, such as picking up supplies or arranging dry cleaning for event materials.
* Help set up event spaces, tables, signage, registration areas, and equipment.
* Set up and troubleshoot event technology as needed.
* Assist with event breakdown, packing, and returning materials to storage.
* Provide hands-on support during events and step in where needed to keep things running smoothly.
* Occasionally coordinate volunteers at events, making sure they know where to be and what they're responsible for.
* Help lead games or interactive activities when appropriate.

**Administrative & Organizational Support**

* Use the team's existing master checklists, project trackers, templates, and instructions to guide your work.
* Keep assigned tasks moving and update their status in the appropriate tracking tools.
* Keep shared directories and file repositories organized and up to date.
* Prepare, organize, and update event documents, materials, and SOPs so they stay current, and occasionally write new SOPs when a process needs one.
* Handle physical mail and packages, including receiving deliveries, shipping items, and sending postcards and other mailings.
* Keep track of deadlines, outstanding assignments, and details that need attention.
* Follow established processes and ask questions when instructions or information are unclear.
* Flag missing information, delays, or problems early so they can be addressed.

**Ownership & Problem-Solving**

* Take responsibility for assigned tasks from start to finish without needing constant supervision.
* Use the information and tools provided to determine next steps and make steady progress.
* Communicate proactively about progress, obstacles, and anything that needs a decision.
* Notice what needs attention and offer help when appropriate.
* Adapt when plans change and remain calm when unexpected issues arise.
* Follow through on commitments and make sure completed work is reflected in the appropriate tracking tools.
* Suggest practical improvements when you notice opportunities to make event preparation or execution smoother.

**Who We're Looking For**

We care more about how you work than whether your career has followed a traditional path.

You might have experience in event production, film, entertainment, administration, operations, project support, hospitality, or another hands-on field. You might be building experience while pursuing other professional interests, or bringing years of experience from a previous career into a flexible role with a meaningful mission.

What matters most is that you're capable, dependable, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of your work.

**You'll likely be a good fit if you:**

* **Take ownership.** Once you know how we work, you can take an assignment, understand what it's for, and see it through without needing constant check-ins.
* **Make our systems work for you.** We have checklists, trackers, and simple processes that make the work easier. You're happy to use them, keep your tasks updated as you go, and help the team see where things stand.
* **Follow through.** You remember the details, meet deadlines, and make sure things are actually finished—not just started.
* **Communicate clearly.** You ask good questions, share updates, and flag problems before they become bigger issues.
* **Take initiative.** You notice what needs doing, anticipate practical needs, and step in when appropriate.
* **Think ahead about materials.** When a teammate pitches an idea or wants to add something to an event, you start picturing what it will take: what needs to be bought, printed, borrowed, built, or picked up, and by when.
* **Stay resourceful under pressure.** You can adjust when plans change, solve everyday problems, and keep a level head when an event gets busy.
* **Enjoy hands-on work.** You're comfortable moving supplies, setting up spaces, running errands, and helping with whatever needs attention.
* **Bring positive energy.** You're comfortable interacting with different people and can help create a welcoming, engaging atmosphere at events.
* **Care about the mission.** You appreciate the opportunity to help create experiences that make a difference for young people.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Strong organizational skil

jobs.title: Event Coordinator/Production Assistant (Freelance)
jobs.description:
The Freelance Event Coordinator / Production Assistant supports the Events & Brand Experiences team with the planning, coordination, execution, staffing and post-production of events across Caruso properties. This role is remote/work-from-home during pre-production phases, with onsite support required for load in and event execution days, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Assist with event load-in, setup, and onsite production needs.
* Assist with event plans and pre-production deliverables for upcoming events.
* Assist with securing vendors and tracking deliverables.
* Assist with production timelines and operational planning.
* Place orders and track deliveries for event materials and supplies.
* Coordinate vendor confirmations and communications.
* Assist with contracts and collection of Certificates of Insurance (COIs).
* Assist with operational plans and event logistics.
* Prepare event materials including giveaways, signage and brand elements.
* Maintain inventory checklists and assist with inventory management processes .
* Update and maintain vendor lists and databases.
* Support guest check-in and guest experience onsite.
* Assist with event strike and load-out procedures.
* Assist with post-event recaps and key learnings documentation.
* Assist with budget reconciliation and invoice follow-up.
* Assist with inventory reconciliation and organization.

**MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Excellent organizational and multitasking skills with strong attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a professional demeanor
* Ability to work independently in a remote/work-from-home environment while meeting deadlines.
* Flexible schedule with availability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays based on event needs.
* Comfortable working in fast-paced event environments and managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong problem-solving, time management, and follow-up skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and basic event management platforms.
* Ability to maintain professionalism when communicating with vendors, clients, guests, and internal teams.
* Previous event, hospitality, production, or administrative experience preferred.
* Familiarity with inventory management systems

**SCHEDULE:**

Work schedule may vary based on event schedules and production timelines. This position requires flexibility in work hours, including the possibility of working nights, weekends, and holidays to support event needs. Most pre-production responsibilities may be completed remotely; however, onsite attendance is required for event setup, execution, and breakdown.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* Onsite event support is required working outdoors and in varying weather conditions.
* Opportunity to work remote/work-from-home during planning and administrative phases.
* Professional business attire is expected during onsite event support.
* Computer work is required for event planning, communication, budgeting, inventory management, and vendor coordination.
* Physical requirements may include standing, walking, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, bending, and extended periods of activity during events.
* Travel between Southern California properties may be required depending on event needs.
* Proficiency in English is vital as it serves as the primary language of communication with team members, vendors, and guests.

Pay: $25.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* This is a freelance opportunity, hours for this role are not guaranteed and may vary from week to week. Does this work for you?
* The hourly rate for this position is $25/hour - does this work for you?
* This role will require some remote support, as well as on-site event set-up at Caruso properties across the Greater Los Angeles area. Does this work for you?
* Why are you interested in this opportunity?

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Corporate Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
### ***Elevate Your Career with a Dynamic Corporate Marketing Role***

**GENERAL DESCRIPTION:**

Promote awareness of the company, hotel, and restaurant/bar/outlets images internally and externally. Create and execute social media posts and campaigns as well as respond to guest comments on these channels. Help develop marketing materials and assemble information packages (e.g., brochures, promotional materials, maps, etc.) for promotional events: property tours, and conferences. Prepare or edit letters, invitations, monthly and quarterly internal e-newsletters, press reports, and news releases, using word processing, spreadsheet, database, or presentation software. Make updates to property website. Assist with photo and video shoots. Respond to all daily general media inquiries or refer to an appropriate spokesperson. Monitor media coverage and other external factors to identify potential or actual problem areas and opportunities. Support media/influencer relations outreach efforts and other activities to bolster the property's reputation and image in the community. Coordinate on-property visits from media/influencers, including reservations, amenities, special requests, and dining. File and update press database, digital library, and press clippings.

Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect the privacy and security of guests and coworkers. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests’ service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answers telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats. Move, lift, carry, pull and place objects weighing less or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by supervisors.

The ideal candidate will be excited to take on a multitude of projects from start to finish.

**Brand Stewardship & Multi-Property Alignment**

* Ensuring all digital collateral, print media, and signage strictly adhere to brand guidelines.
* Update marketing calendars, promotional asset distribution, and asset libraries across multiple hotel properties or food & beverage (F&B) outlets.
* Help update brochure and property collateral materials, including all property imaging work (e.g., signage).
* Assist e-commerce with updating content on all web sites (e.g. hotel, restaurant, etc.).

**Digital Marketing & Content Creation**

* Creating, scheduling, and analyzing organic social content across platforms (Instagram, LinkedIn, Meta).
* Live content capture during media events or site activations when required.
* Track articles on operations and property events.
* Working knowledge of basic design tools like **Canva** or **Adobe Creative Cloud** (Photoshop, InDesign) to adjust collateral, flyers, menu updates, and digital signage.

**Website & Online Travel Agency (OTA) Maintenance**

* Updating copy, package offers, photo galleries, and landing pages on property websites.
* Regularly checking local listings (Google Business Profile, TripAdvisor) and third-party OTAs (Expedia, Booking.com) to ensure high-resolution photos, amenity lists, and descriptions are accurate.

**Public Relations, Events & Partnerships**

* Coordinating site visits, hosting media dinners, drafting press release distribution lists, and organizing influencer itineraries.
* Assisting with corporate events, property milestone celebrations, trade shows, and community involvement initiatives.
* Evaluate new marketing opportunities for the property.
* Ensure property is represented on all quality internet sites that have the potential of providing business.

**Building Successful Relationships that Generate Sales & Marketing Opportunities**

* Build and strengthen relationships with existing and new travel writers and local media to ensure future exposure; conducting site inspections with visiting journalists and handling calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc.
* Develop relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for sales opportunities and additional revenue; coordinating community service activities in concert with the public image and needs of the hotel.

**ADDITIONAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES**

* Report all suspicious people or activities and hazardous or unsafe conditions to the security department.
* Respond to guest questions. Provide guest assistance, direction and information as requested when working in public areas.
* Ensure that property follows all corporate marketing guidelines.
* Represent the hotel at various functions and trade shows.

* Available to work at various days and times, as required. Includes, weekends, Holidays and evenings.

jobs.title: Operational Account Manager, Freight Operations, Road US
jobs.description:
If you are a current DSV employee and interested in a position in another country,please contact your Human Resource representative to discuss the process and requirements of applying.

Job area: Customer Operations Management

**DSV - Global transport and logistics**

  

In 1976, ten independent hauliers joined forces and founded DSV in Denmark. Since then, DSV has evolved to become the world's 3rd largest supplier of global solutions within transport and logistics. Today, we add value to our customers' entire supply chain by transporting, storing, packaging, re-packaging, processing and clearing all types of goods. We work every day from our many offices in more than 80 countries to ensure a steady supply of goods to production lines, outlets, stores and consumers all over the world. Our reach is global yet our presence is local and close to our customers. Read more at www.dsv.com

Location: USA - Torrance, S Western Ave

Division: Road
  
Job Posting Title: Operational Account Manager, Freight Operations, Road US
  
Time Type: Full Time

  

**Summary**
  
The Operational Account Manager, Freight Operations is an integral part of the Road US team’s freight brokerage operations and assist with the establishment and development of relationships with customers by providing exceptional customer service. They are responsible for developing the branch’s house accounts, while continuously seeking out new growth opportunities with current and new clients and oversee the flow of communication with clients regarding all aspects of the account.

  

**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Develops the overall customer relationship via all methods of communication, phone, email, and in person.
* Negotiates with transportation carriers and providers to obtain, set rates and determine services available.
* Researches and determines growth opportunities within the branch’s house accounts.
* Investigates, actions and establishes new customer leads and opportunities.
* Examines customer requests to provide best service options and pricing available.
* Proactively handles customer shipment requests.
* Utilizes our TMS system and provides data input to facilitate material movement, planning, and scheduling.
* Provides direction and sets pricing guidelines for Carrier Sales team.
* Monitors shipment tracking progression from pickup through delivery and communicates accurate and up-to-date information to the customer and/or Key Account Manager.
* Ensures customer expectations are met or exceeded through close communication with Carrier Sales team.
* Tracks and traces shipments from pickup through delivery to ensure accurate and up-to-date shipment information is being provided to customers.
* Prepares spend reports as needed and holds regular check ins via QBR or MBR with the customer.
* Other duties and project work as assigned by manager.
  

**Minimum Required Qualifications** **Education and/or Experience**

* High School diploma.
* 3 years’ experience in logistics, transportation brokerage, or related field.
  

**Skills, Knowledge & Abilities** **Computer Skills**

* Proficient with all Microsoft Office applications, Word, Excel, Teams and PowerPoint.
* Solid analytical experience in Excel required.
* Experience with transportation management systems.
  

**Language Skills**

* English (reading, writing, verbal)
  

**Mathematical Skills**

* Position requires strong mathematical skills for pricing, negotiating and project development
  

**Other Skills**

* Superior leadership skills and ability to build and cultivate strong relationships
* Driven, enthusiastic, and highly motivated
* High attention to detail and ability to multitask
* Strong organizational skills
* Ability to thrive under deadlines and work in a team environment, while also delivering independent results
* Excellent interpersonal communication and problem-solving skills, verbal, written and in person
* Strong prioritization skills and works with a sense of urgency
* Proficiency in using a Windows-based computer
* Strong ability to persuade, negotiate, and influence others

jobs.description:
**What We Do**

At GoGuardian, we're helping build a future where all learners are ready and inspired to solve the world's greatest challenges. Our award-winning system of learning solutions is purpose-built for K-12 and trusted by school leaders to promote effective teaching and equitable engagement while helping empower educators to keep students safe.

**What It's Like to Work at GoGuardian**

We are an outcomes-focused learning company with a steadfast focus on improving learning environments, one classroom at a time. Working with us means joining a remote team of diverse, committed, mission-driven employees who are inspired by our vision, dedicated to our customers, and ready to roll up their sleeves. Guardians put their heads together to solve problems, learn together from experiments that fail, and stand together by their work with full accountability. We balance our diligence with an inclusive culture that invites everyone to bring their whole self to work. Join us and learn why "I love the people here" is one of the most frequent comments we hear from Guardians.

**The Role**

We are looking for an exceptional individual to own GoGuardian's channel partner business within a defined region. This role combines data-driven decision making, partner relationship management, and business development. You will bring significant experience working with resellers and distributors in the educational technology sector, and you'll be a self-starter and energy amplifier with a proven ability to turn strategy into regional growth.

You will own your region's partner portfolio end to end, from joint business plans and pipeline to onboarding new partners and resolving channel conflict. You'll work alongside our Channel Operations Specialist, who runs the operational side of our indirect business, so your time stays focused on partners, pipeline, and results. Your success will be measured by the strength of your partner relationships and the growth of your region's pipeline and bookings.

This role will live within close driving distance of a major Southeast airport as this role will represent us at field events requiring travel up to 30% of the time.

**What You'll Do**

* **Regional Partner Ownership & Development:** Own the portfolio of resellers, distributors, and solution partners in your region, building strong relationships between partner and GoGuardian reps and leadership. Lead new partner onboarding and grow existing partners' capabilities and performance.
* **Data-Driven Performance & Business Reviews:** Analyze data on regional performance, identify growth opportunities, and lead partner business reviews to evaluate results, address gaps, and drive improvement.
* **Pipeline Development & Forecasting:** Build and manage a robust pipeline across your regional partner network, supporting accurate forecasting, execution of joint business plans, and consistent growth in bookings.
* **Sales Alignment & Account Planning:** Drive sales planning, account mapping, and partner alignment with GoGuardian's regional sales teams to identify opportunities and generate pipeline.
* **Channel Program Execution:** Lead regional execution of channel programs, including partner SPIFs, events, and collaborative initiatives that drive partner engagement and business growth.
* **Escalations, Collaboration & Continuous Improvement:** Manage regional partner escalations, customer satisfaction, and channel conflicts while partnering with Channel Operations, Sales, and cross-functional GoGuardian teams. Collaborate with fellow Regional CAMs to drive shared success. Stay current on industry trends and adapt regional strategies to meet evolving market demands.

**Who You Are**

* Related experience in channel account management, business development, or partner management, with a strong emphasis on resellers and distributors.
* Proven expertise in data analysis and decision-making leveraging AI. You can interpret large datasets and turn them into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.
* Experience with performance metrics, incentive programs, and pipeline management. You're comfortable using dashboards and reports to communicate results and progress.
* A track record of owning a territory or partner portfolio and growing its bookings.
* Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, and the ability to present complex data and strategies clearly, from partner sellers to senior leadership.
* Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset who drives initiatives independently and rallies cross-functional teams to achieve results.
* Proven track record of building strong relationships and working collaboratively with partners to drive mutual business success.
* High energy and passion for technology and education. You're excited about amplifying partner success and bringing innovative solutions to schools and districts.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive pay, complete health insurance, 401(k) matching, and an employee equity plan.
* Flexible time off, paid holidays, paid parental leave, and a paid year-end holiday break.
* A robust catalog of benefits that support your professional growth and personal wellbeing, including work from home funds, fertility & adoption reimbursement, and more…

*Plus the intangible:*

* A varied and challenging role in an innovative, global company.
* Supportive, driven colleagues who have your back and share your passion.

Additional benefits information is listed on our careers page.

jobs.description:
***Launch Your Sales Career at Bisnow | 2027 BDR Class | July 6 Start***

***Bisnow is opening early recruitment for our 2027 Business Development Representative class — hiring hungry, high-potential candidates across multiple major US markets for a July 6, 2027 start date.***  
  
***We welcome upcoming Spring 2027 graduates, recent graduates, and early-career professionals with 0–1 years of experience from any background in sales. No prior real estate experience required — just strong communication skills, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in B2B media sales.***  
  
***This is a first job that becomes a career. You’ll partner with clients across the commercial real estate industry, be in the room at 400+ live events a year, and follow a clear path from BDR to Business Manager in a culture that genuinely promotes from within. Expected in office 3 - 4 days per week. Office location: Blank Spaces- 929 Colorado Ave, Santa Monica, CA.***

**BISNOW OVERVIEW**  
Bisnow is the leading B2B media platform powering the commercial real estate industry. We connect CRE professionals through award-winning news, high-impact events, marketing solutions, recruiting services, and sales enablement tools that drive real business results.  
  
With 1.7M+ subscribers and 400+ events annually across 47 markets in the U.S., Canada, the UK, Ireland, and the Netherlands, we don’t just cover the industry, we help move it forward.

We inform. We connect. We create opportunities that turn into deals. Global mindset. Hyper-local execution.  
  
**SUMMARY OF ROLE**  
As a BDR (Business Development Rep) you will be trained in all aspects of the products and solutions that we sell to the commercial real estate market. You will then work with the sales team to create new meetings, proposals and then contracts for clients. Your days will consist of training, taking meetings with clients, attending events to network and learn about our industry. Your goal as an BDR is to ultimately be promoted into a business manager. Once a business manager, you will begin to build your own book of business. If you want to learn how to be a successful business development executive and are willing to work hard and learn, this is a great opportunity for you.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Build and own relationships with marketing decision-makers across all asset classes and sectors in your target markets — this is a relationship-first role.
* Drive sponsorship sales for both digital and in-person events through sharp prospecting research, outreach, and follow-through from first contact to confirmed sponsor.
* Prospect new business daily to build a strong pipeline and develop into an expert at identifying and targeting the right people at the right companies.
* Connect with prospects through phone and email with confidence and creativity — and respond to every inbound lead like it matters, because it does.
* Partner with the event production team to shape sponsor-friendly programs that genuinely align with what our clients care about.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and bring fresh, relevant ideas to the table — the best people here think like journalists and sell like entrepreneurs.
* Know your numbers. Understand individual and team KPIs and show up every day with a plan to hit them — then push past them.
* Keep Salesforce updated and accurate — your pipeline is your business and your documentation reflects how seriously you take it.
* Work closely with a high-energy, cross-functional team to drive sponsorship, marketing, and event performance across the board.

### **What are we looking for?**

* **0–1 years of sales or client-facing experience** — internships, campus jobs, and side hustles count. We care about what you’ve done, not just where.
* **Innate hustle, raw intelligence, and infectious enthusiasm** — you’re the person who finds a way, not a reason. You make the room more energetic just by being in it.
* **Entrepreneurial but disciplined** — you think like an owner and execute like a professional. Creative enough to find new angles, organized enough to follow through.
* **A fast learner who stays curious** — we’re constantly bringing new digital and event products to market. You’ll need to understand them, believe in them, and sell them. If you love learning how things work, you’ll thrive here.
* **A proven team player** — athletics, clubs, Greek life, group projects, volunteer work — show us a moment where you elevated the people around you.
* **Hungry to be client-facing** — this role is your launchpad into an externally facing sales career. You should be excited about that, not just open to it.
* **Genuinely curious about commercial real estate, media, and digital marketing** — you don’t need to know the industry cold, but you should want to. Our best people become obsessed with the space they cover.
* **Coachable above all else** — you welcome feedback, act on it fast, and don’t take it personally. The best salespeople in this building got there because they listened.
* **Built for a fast-paced environment** — things move quickly here and priorities shift. You stay focused, adapt without drama, and bring energy on the hard days too.

### **What's in it for you?**

* Competitive compensation structure
* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
* Maternity and paternity leaves
* 401K
* Flexible Spending Account
* Dependent Care Account
* Health Savings Account
* **Unlimited Vacation Days**
* 7 days paid sick leave
* 9 paid Holidays
* Referral Bonus Program
* You’ll get to work with incredibly smart, passionate, driven, ambitious, kind, caring and mindful people and will rarely experience an overload of policies, bureaucracy or toxicity (the latter, we do not tolerate).

Uncapped monthly bonuses tied to a performance-based step scale: the more you close, the more you earn.

Nickey Kehoe is committed to building a category-defining and enduring company and culture. We believe in creating a sanctuary from chaos by creating spaces that are grounding and beautiful.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Retail Operations Coordinator keeps Nickey Kehoe’s designated retail and office locations functional, supplied, and equipped for daily operations. Reporting to the Senior Retail Operations Manager, this role coordinates facilities maintenance, supply purchasing, everyday technology support, and routine operational reporting. The coordinator answers basic system questions using established standard operating procedures (SOPs), helps employees resolve routine issues, and follows through with service providers when additional support is needed.

**DUTIES INCLUDE**

**Facilities and Maintenance**

* Proactively identify maintenance needs and coordinate preventive service and repairs for building systems, fixtures, and equipment at assigned locations.
* Support landlord coordination as directed by the Senior Retail Operations Manager or Director of Operations, including relaying routine updates and arranging access for service visits
* Obtain quotes, schedule approved vendors, coordinate site access, and confirm work is complete while limiting disruption to store and office activities.
* Maintain service schedules, vendor contacts, warranties, repair histories, and open requests. Escalate urgent conditions and costs outside approved authority.
* Support assigned installations and workplace improvement projects under the direction of the Senior Retail Operations Manager.
* Coordinate workspace setup and seating changes as headcount grows, including arranging furniture, equipment, and installation according to plans approved by management.

**Supplies and Purchasing**

* Monitor and replenish packaging, office, kitchen, janitorial, and other operational supplies; maintain reorder levels to prevent shortages.
* Compare vendor pricing and lead times, consolidate orders where practical, and place purchases within approved budgets and purchasing authority.
* Track deliveries, resolve order discrepancies, and verify invoices against orders and receipts before submitting to Accounts Payable.

**Technology and Systems Support**

* Answer basic questions about Shopify and other approved systems by referring employees to existing SOPs and guiding them through documented steps.
* Provide basic troubleshooting for computers, tablets, printers, scanners, and POS equipment using approved procedures; coordinate technical issues with the external IT provider.
* When documented steps do not resolve an issue and a software bug is suspected, help open a ticket with Shopify Support or the relevant application provider. Capture screenshots, error messages, steps to reproduce the issue, and operational impact.
* Track support tickets through resolution, communicate updates, and confirm the issue is resolved with the affected employee. Escalate process questions not covered by an SOP to the appropriate internal owner.
* Maintain equipment assignment records and coordinate approved onboarding and offboarding requests, including device setup, returns, and account access changes, with HR and the IT provider.

**Reporting and Coordination**

* Maintain a shared request tracker for facilities, supplies, and technology issues, recording priority, owner, status, and next steps.
* Prepare concise updates on open requests, recurring issues, supply and maintenance spending, and upcoming needs for the Senior Retail Operations Manager.
* Pull established operational reports as assigned and flag exceptions for review. Identify gaps in existing SOPs and refer proposed updates to the responsible process owner.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by management.

Systems responsibilities are limited to support using approved procedures, documentation, and escalation. Business rules, data governance standards, data accuracy audits, and technical administration remain with the designated business and technology owners.

**QUALIFICATIONS & KEY ATTRIBUTES**

* 3-5 years experience in workplace operations, retail operations, facilities coordination, office administration, or a similar support role.
* Strong organization and follow through, with the ability to coordinate vendors, track requests, and manage priorities across multiple locations.
* Comfort with basic technology troubleshooting and the ability to explain established procedures clearly and patiently.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace and Excel or Google Sheets, including maintaining trackers, sorting and filtering information, and using basic formulas.
* Familiarity with Shopify or Shopify POS is preferred, along with experience using support tickets or project management tools.
* Experience obtaining quotes, purchasing supplies, reviewing invoices, and working within approved budgets.
* Clear written and verbal communication, attention to detail, discretion with company information, and sound judgment about when to escalate issues.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

Work is performed in retail and office environments and includes computer use, walking locations to identify service needs, and coordinating onsite vendors.

MindDo AI is an innovative AI education company dedicated to helping the next generation become AI creators, builders, and entrepreneurs.

Our programs go beyond traditional coding classes. Students learn to build real-world AI applications, develop products, launch projects, and explore entrepreneurship through hands-on learning.

We are expanding our presence in Southern California and beyond, serving both English-speaking and Chinese-speaking families.

We are looking for an experienced, highly analytical, and results-driven **Growth Marketing Manager** to own and accelerate student enrollment growth.

This is not a traditional marketing or social media management position. We need someone who can build and execute a comprehensive growth strategy, generate qualified parent leads, increase trial-class bookings, and ultimately drive new student enrollments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on growth operator who combines strategic thinking, strong technical marketing capabilities, creative experimentation, and measurable business results.

* Demonstrated success generating qualified leads and driving measurable customer acquisition or revenue growth.
* Proven experience independently managing paid advertising campaigns and optimizing budgets.
* Strong working knowledge of SEO, conversion optimization, marketing analytics, and growth experimentation.
* Familiarity with GEO/AEO and how AI-powered discovery is changing customer acquisition.
* Proficiency with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, GA4, Google Search Console, and related growth tools.

* Successful experience acquiring customers in both Chinese-American and broader English-speaking markets.

jobs.description:
Roland DGA is in need of an ambitious and talented Sales Development Representative looking to join a dynamic and fast-paced sales organization. We want someone who is driven, results-oriented, and has a natural instinct for sales to join our team. This person will take pride in maximizing the effectiveness of our marketing efforts and will play a critical role in growing the business. If you have a ton of smarts, are equally as fun, and thrive on teamwork and winning… this is the place for you! This is an entry-level, full-time position based in our corporate office in Irvine, CA, following a hybrid schedule of 3 days in the office and 2 days remote. Spanish fluency is required.

**The Roland DGA Family**  
Roland DGA Corporation serves North and South America as the sales, marketing, distribution and service arm for Roland DG Corporation of Hamamatsu, Japan. Roland DG is a worldwide leader in wide-format inkjet printers for the sign, textile and personalization markets; engravers for awards, giftware, signage and direct part marking; and desktop 3D printers and milling machines for the dental CAD/CAM, product prototyping and medical industries.

Roland DGA is a nine-time winner of the Orange County Register Top Workplace Award. We prioritize our positive culture and a creative, team-oriented environment, and offer an attractive benefits package including continuing education and 401k matching. If you are goal oriented and driven to grow both personally and professionally, then this is the company for you.

**Position Purpose**  
Under the direction of the Sr. Director of Customer Development, the Sales Development Representative (SDR) engages with new and existing sales prospects across North and South America through channels such as telephone, email, and web chat. The SDR generates new sales opportunities for our sales channels and follows up on leads created by Roland DGA through trade shows, advertisements, web forms, and CRM mining.

In addition, the SDR conducts regular outbound campaigns and leverages lead-generation platforms to identify new opportunities. This role collaborates closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product Management teams to maximize prospect engagement, strengthen the sales pipeline, and increase closed-won rates.

**Essential Functions & Basic Duties**

**Lead Management & CRM**

* Manage and document all sales opportunities in a CRM, ensuring accurate tracking and timely updates.
* Handle inbound pre-sales inquiries via phone, email, web chat, and social media to generate qualified opportunities.
* Follow up on dealer-distributed opportunities to confirm prospect engagement, purchase outcomes, or pending status.
* Close out opportunities in a CRM once they have reached the end of their lifecycle.
* Set up new customer accounts and update contact profiles to maintain clean and accurate CRM data.
* Utilize CRM and database-mining platforms to build prospect lists and support outreach initiatives.

**Sales Development & Outreach**

* Manage the Sales Development email queue and respond to inquiries in a timely manner.
* Execute targeted communication campaigns to customers and prospects, promoting sales initiatives, special offers, and equipment updates.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Product Management on lead and opportunity distribution, campaigns, and strategic initiatives.
* Assist with pre-sales email outreach and post-show lead processing to maximize event ROI.

**Relationship Building & Representation**

* Develop and maintain positive relationships with prospects, customers, and dealer partners.
* Participate in industry trade shows and educational events, representing Roland DGA professionally.
* Present sales materials at corporate and dealer training sessions to support product and sales enablement.

**Reporting & Professionalism**

* Generate and deliver Sales and Marketing reports to support business insights.
* Uphold Roland’s highest professional and ethical standards as outlined in the Employee Handbook.

**Performance Measurements**  
**Lead & Opportunity Management**

* Consistently qualify and convert sales leads in a timely and accurate manner.
* Maintain thorough documentation of activities and demonstrate strong product knowledge in all customer interactions.

Customer Engagement

* Drive consistent outbound communication and follow-up with customers and prospects.
* Take full ownership of assigned inquiries, ensuring professional resolution and follow-through.

**Collaboration & Team Contribution**

* Actively support departmental goals and contribute to the achievement of company objectives.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, and Product Management.

**Task Execution & Accountability**

* Complete daily, weekly, monthly, and special assignments within established timelines.
* Demonstrate accuracy, reliability, and attention to detail in all deliverables.

**Professional Standards**

* Receive positive peer feedback during performance reviews as an indicator of teamwork and professionalism.
* Adhere to company policies and guidelines, including attendance, punctuality, and ethical standards as outlined in Roland’s Employee Handbook.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of two years’ experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, or Marketing.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Collaborative team player who builds positive relationships across departments.
* Knowledge of Sales Development processes and systems is a plus.
* Familiarity with wide-format printing, cutting, engraving, and/or 3D milling technologies is a plus.
* Spanish language fluency (spoken and written) is required for this role.

**SALARY RANGE:** $55,000 - $60,000 +

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Join a nonprofit organization dedicated to improving our community through programs that provide equal access to legal services. The Justice & Diversity Center of The Bar Association of San Francisco (JDC) has an exciting opportunity for a part-time **Federal Pro Bono Project Coordinator** to be part of the team!

**About JDC**

JDC is a non-profit organization which provides free legal services through its staff and volunteers to low-income Bay Area residents. Each year more than 1,600 volunteer attorneys, legal assistants, and law students work with JDC staff to serve nearly 7,500 indigent clients. JDC’s holistic advocacy approach seeks to address the social service and legal needs of clients.

**About the Job**

The Federal Pro Bono Project Coordinator will work with JDC’s Federal Pro Bono Project, reporting to and working with the Supervising Attorney and Senior Staff Attorney. The Federal Pro Bono Project assists self-represented litigants in two ways: (1) staff attorneys at Legal Help Centers in the San Francisco and Oakland federal courthouses provide legal advice and guidance on federal civil cases; and (2) the Project matches litigants with volunteer attorneys to represent them in their cases.

This is a part-time position working 15 hours per week. Working hours are flexible but must be performed during regular business hours, Monday through Friday. The schedule should remain reasonably consistent from week to week. The position is fully remote, but office space is available at JDC’s downtown location should the successful candidate prefer to work some or all of their hours in a more social setting.

As the first point of contact for litigants communicating with the Project, the Coordinator is a critical part of the Project team. The Coordinator’s primary responsibilities are to conduct intakes and screening by phone and email, and to schedule appointments with the Project attorneys when appropriate. The Coordinator uses strong communication and organizational skills to keep the Project’s Legal Help Center legal advice work on track and ensure that litigants eligible for assistance are scheduled in a timely manner. The Coordinator also assists with outreach, database upkeep, development of resources, and improvement of best practices.

The Coordinator works at a fast pace using multiple computer applications, to schedule clients, and communicate with the Project attorneys. Command of Microsoft Office applications is essential for success in the position.

This position is not eligible for benefits and is not an attorney position.

**Education & Experience:**

· Relevant education, training, and experience to perform the essential duties of the position

· Experience in the legal field is helpful but not required

**Skills & Requirements:**

* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications including Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel
* Ability to toggle between communication applications at a fast pace
* Professional verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to interact with clients courteously and with cultural humility
* Efficient self-starter with strong organization and time management skills
* Careful attention to detail

The Project team offers a small, supportive work environment within a larger organization and the opportunity to collaborate with a progressive work culture and a diverse staff. Additionally, we are a mission and values-based organization.

jobs.description:
**Mission Graduates** is a nonprofit organization that increases the number of K-12 students in San Francisco's Mission District who are prepared for and complete a college education. We work towards fulfilling our mission through a wide range of afterschool support services that serve over 4,800 children, youth, and families each year. Our vision is to transform the culture of our neighborhood so that college becomes the expectation for Mission families, rather than the exception.

**Program Summary:** Mission Graduates has been providing quality afterschool programming for its entire 50-year history. The organization is partnering with June Jordan School of Equity (JJSE) to develop and implement a quality afterschool program that blends extracurricular activities and builds a college-going culture on campus. Youth who participate in the program develop a sense of self-confidence in their ability to learn, to speak their voice, and contribute to their community. The program infuses college messaging throughout its curriculum to ensure both youth and parents develop or strengthen expectations for entering college.

  

**Key Responsibilities & Primary Duties**

### **Program Management & Evaluation (25%)**

Assist in the maintenance of all program records, particularly maintenance of attendance.  
Assist the Director in developing and managing the annual program budget.  
Maintain knowledge of ExCEL policies and procedures.  
Assist in program evaluation and the utilization of evaluation findings in program development to ensure positive outcomes.  
Assist in the preparation of funding proposals and reports to funders.

### **Program Quality, Support, & Delivery (50%)**

* Work with program staff to deliver quality afterschool programming, including supervision of at least three clubs or programs.

  + Lead the JJSE leadership student group, meeting weekly. Create meeting agendas, lead activities, and support students in running school-wide events.
  + Manage the academic tutoring program and referral process.
* Uphold all school-site policies for safety, supervision, mandated reporting, and risk management.

* Assist in the preparation of internal marketing materials to be disseminated to students, parents, and the JJSE community.
* Collaborate closely with community stakeholders including parents and caregivers, community-based organizations, and SFUSD.
* Assist the JJSE Director in developing parent engagement activities and maintaining positive parent relations with current JJSE families.
* Assist and lead summer programming in academics, enrichment, and/or recreation.

### **Supervise Consultants & Volunteers (10%)**

* In collaboration with other MG team members, oversee recruitment, training, and supervision of volunteers and program consultants.
* Assist/Support the SFUSD teachers and staff who are given stipends to implement Extended Day clubs and activities.

### **Family Recruitment and Outreach (15%)**

* Engaging with families to facilitate two-way communication and information sharing, highlighting school and program activities at JJSE.
* Attend high school tabling events at middle schools and positively represent JJSE to prospective families.
* Reach out to prospective high school families in the neighborhood and middle schools to share JJSE programs and schedule school tours.

### **Required Qualifications**

* 1-2 years of proven experience and ability in working in education and/or youth programs.
* Demonstrated knowledge of and experience with best practices in youth development program planning, curriculum development, teaching methods, and evaluation.
* Familiarity with college access challenges that are specific to first-generation college students.
* Familiarity and experience working with undocumented youth.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Music School Program Coordinator provides administrative and operational support for CSMA’s Music School. The primary responsibility of this position is driving enrollment for both current and prospective students. Fulfillment of this responsibility requires coordinating faculty schedules, breaks, and availability using strong interpersonal communication and collaboration skills.

A secondary responsibility of this role is handling logistics for all Music School recitals. This includes managing event scheduling, ensuring necessary resources and equipment are provided, and attending recitals in person to facilitate the needs of faculty, student performers, and guests.

Reporting to the Music School Director, this position also works in alignment with the Music Classes & Faculty Supervisor to handle faculty needs and logistics. This is a key support role that requires high interpersonal resilience, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to provide professional support to faculty.

**Primary Roles and Responsibilities**

* **Enrollment Coordination:** Actively drive the enrollment process by managing new inquiries, conducting follow-up communication via phone and email, and navigating registration software. The priority in this operational area is to provide the level of follow-through necessary to maximize student enrollment and retention.
* **Faculty Schedules & Support:** Manage faculty teaching schedules, availability, and breaks with high precision. Optimize room schedules, resolve calendar conflicts, and serve as the primary point of contact for assigned faculty.
* **Recital Coordination:** Lead all logistical and administrative operations for student recitals (~40/semester), including communications, resources, and program creation. Responsible for in-person attendance and support at recitals, which requires working some weekends.
* **Student Lifecycle Support:** Coordinate the administrative logistics and success of trial lessons, teacher transfers, make-ups, and withdrawals, collaborating closely with faculty to ensure accurate record-keeping and process completion.
* **Customer Service:** Serve as a front-end representative, welcoming families and delivering exceptional customer service to ensure a positive and personable experience for students and parents.
* **Professional Composure:** Maintain a warm and helpful demeanor while supporting faculty, parents, and students. This role requires the ability to remain objective and professional when navigating interactions with assertive personalities, managing family concerns, or addressing faculty needs under pressure.
* **Student Services Collaboration:** Partner with the Student Services team as a key collaborator to ensure student data is accurate and that families experience a smooth transition from inquiry to active enrollment.
* **Departmental Assistance:** Provide occasional administrative support to cross-program areas and events, including the Music Classes program, as requested.

**Skills, Qualifications & Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in administration, arts management, or related field. A music degree is not required.
* **Working experience:**  2+ years of work experience with customer service, scheduling, or a relevant area. Strong background in music, music education, or instrumental/voice study to evaluate student needs and operate effectively within a music school.
* **Process & Detail Orientation:** Exceptional attention to detail and strong multitasking skills, with a proven ability to navigate complex, multi-step workflows. Proficient in managing information across multiple resources simultaneously, including registration systems, calendars, spreadsheets, and communication channels, to execute operations without error.
* **Event Coordination:** Strong real-time problem-solving skills to ensure seamless recital operations. Adept at assisting faculty and attendees during recitals while working collaboratively with concert hall and facility staff to manage logistics.
* **Independent Operation:** Ability to work independently and solve problems in real time when other administrative personnel are not available. Must remain calm and resourceful to effectively resolve unexpected logistical or client issues without immediate managerial oversight.
* **Professional Maturity & Composure:** Professional maturity, ability to remain calm, composed, and solutions-focused when navigating high-pressure situations, tight deadlines, or challenging interactions.
* **Google Workspace & Technology:** Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Sites, and Sheets), alongside a strong adaptability for quickly mastering new registration software, technology, and collaborative administrative tools..
* **Customer Relations & Sales:** Highly personable, building connections across phone, email, and in-person communications. Pairs a warm, accommodating approach with strong drive and enthusiasm to engage families, prioritize inquiries, and grow student enrollment.

**Schedule & Physical Requirements**

**Schedule**

* Occasional weekend availability required to support recitals and special events.

**Physical Requirements**

* Frequently required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms.

**About Hitachi America, Ltd.**

Hitachi America, Ltd. is the regional headquarters for Hitachi Group companies in the Americas, overseeing the U.S., Canada, and Latin America markets. Headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Hitachi Americas has been deeply committed to its Social Innovation Business since its establishment in 1959, addressing society's most pressing challenges through innovative solutions. Leveraging its expertise and resources, Hitachi Americas and its subsidiary companies operate across diverse sectors, including transportation, energy, mobility, industrial manufacturing, healthcare, digital engineering, data analytics and others. Driven by Digital, Green, and Innovation, Hitachi Americas remains at the forefront of pioneering solutions that shape the future. For further details, please visit https://www.hitachi.us/ .

Through its Social Innovation Business (SIB) that brings together IT, OT (Operational Technology) and products, Hitachi contributes to a harmonized society where the environment, wellbeing, and economic growth are in balance. Hitachi operates globally in four sectors – Digital Systems & Services, Energy, Mobility, and Connective Industries – and the Strategic SIB Business Unit for new growth businesses. With Lumada at its core, Hitachi generates value from integrating data, technology and domain knowledge to solve customer and social challenges.

**Summary**

Hitachi America's R&D Division in Santa Clara is Hitachi's research arm in North America. Its labs work with Hitachi's businesses in rail, energy, industry and digital infrastructure, and with research counterparts in Japan, to take new technology from the lab into use. One of its largest current efforts is a multi-site Physical AI program with Hitachi businesses and partners in the Americas, bringing robots and AI systems into the inspection and operation of industrial sites.

  

The Program Coordinator sits in the division's Program Management Office and is the coordinator for this program. The job is to keep its many parties moving together: the division's labs, Hitachi's research centers in Japan and other regions, the Hitachi businesses that host the sites, and outside partners such as technology providers, universities and startups. * Be the first contact for program members and outside parties on schedules, information and logistics. Bring new members from the labs, businesses and partners up to speed, and organize site visits and travel.
* Coordinate with Hitachi's research centers in Japan and other regions so that work on the program stays aligned across time zones, and keep a shared record of who is doing what.
* Follow the Program Management Office's processes for external engagements, agreements and contracts, working with Legal and the business units as needed.
Write status reports and briefing notes for R&D management, business sponsors and counterparts in Japan, with input from the technical leads, and make sure that what goes to partners meets export control, intellectual property and confidentiality rules.  

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, and three or more years coordinating a program with many stakeholders.
* A record of keeping a program on schedule when the people involved sit in several organizations and none of them report to the coordinator.
* Clear writing, and the ability to turn a technical discussion into a short summary that an executive or a partner can act on.
* Careful with detail. Plans, trackers and records stay accurate and current.
* Interest in robotics, AI and industrial technology. A technical background helps but is not required; willingness to learn Hitachi's businesses is essential.
* Comfortable working across organizations, cultures and time zones, including with colleagues in Japan. Experience in an international organization is a plus.
Fluent with AI tools in everyday work, such as drafting and summarizing documents, preparing meeting notes and keeping plans and trackers current, and keen to find where they can take over routine coordination.

jobs.title: SDR
jobs.description:
At Bloom Energy, our vision for a world powered by clean, reliable, and affordable energy is more than just a dream—we’re making it reality.

  

For over two decades, we’ve been at the forefront of the global energy transition, pioneering solutions that empower critical industries to thrive in a rapidly digitizing, energy-intensive world. From revolutionizing power for AI-driven data centers to ensuring resilience for hospitals, electric grids, manufacturing facilities, and utilities, our solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid oxide electrolyzer (SOEC) technologies are redefining what’s possible by delivering energy abundance for all. With more than 30,000 fuel cell modules deployed worldwide, we are the trusted partner for Fortune 100 companies and innovators alike. Our cutting-edge solutions enable unparalleled “time-to-power” capabilities, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring our customers remain ahead in a world where soaring energy demand and intensifying energy scarcity are rapidly becoming the new norm.

  

At Bloom, we thrive on collaboration, bold thinking, and relentless innovation. We believe that, together, we can create a brighter, more sustainable future while tackling the most pressing challenges of the 21st century.

  

Bloom Energy is looking for a driven, curious, and results-oriented **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** to help identify and develop new business opportunities across our target markets.

  

As an SDR, you will be on the front line of Bloom’s go-to-market organization, researching strategic accounts, identifying key decision-makers, and engaging prospects around some of the most important energy challenges businesses face today. You’ll work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners to create qualified pipeline and introduce customers to Bloom Energy’s solutions.

  

This role is ideal for someone who is competitive, comfortable speaking with senior business and operational leaders, and eager to build a career in enterprise sales.

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Research and prioritize target accounts based on factors such as company size, facility footprint, geography, industry, energy requirements, and overall fit.

* Identify and engage key stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Facilities, Engineering, Sustainability, Procurement, and executive leadership.

* Execute thoughtful, multi-channel outbound campaigns using phone, email, LinkedIn, and other prospecting methods.

* Develop personalized outreach based on account-specific business drivers rather than relying solely on high-volume, generic messaging.

* Qualify inbound and outbound opportunities to understand account fit, business needs, timing, stakeholders, and potential energy requirements.

* Schedule qualified meetings and facilitate a clean handoff to the appropriate Account Executive.

* Partner closely with AEs to develop account strategies, prioritize prospects, and expand engagement within strategic accounts.

* Maintain accurate and detailed prospecting, qualification, and activity information in Salesforce and other sales systems.

* Follow up quickly and thoughtfully on inbound inquiries, marketing-generated leads, events, campaigns, and prospect responses.

* Continuously develop your knowledge of Bloom Energy, the energy industry, customer use cases, and the business challenges facing commercial and industrial customers.

* Contribute to a high-performance SDR culture focused on accountability, collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.

  

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Comfortable making outbound calls and engaging prospective customers by phone.

* Ability to research complex organizations and translate research into relevant, personalized outreach.

* Strong organization and attention to detail, particularly when managing multiple accounts and prospects simultaneously.

* Competitive and goal-oriented mindset with the ability to operate in a metrics-driven sales environment.

* Intellectual curiosity and an interest in energy, technology, infrastructure, or enterprise sales.

* Ability to take coaching, adapt quickly, and continuously improve.

* Comfortable working collaboratively with Account Executives, Marketing, and other internal stakeholders.

* Experience with Salesforce, Salesloft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar sales technology is a plus.

  

**Salary Ranges:**
==================

$75,400.00 - $108,600.00

We're looking for an outgoing people-person who loves to network and build local relationships to join us! ### **About Goodie AI:**

Goodie helps leading brands win AI search. As billions of people use ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other AI systems to discover products and make buying decisions, brands need a way to understand and influence how they’re represented.

Goodie gives teams a full AI control plane: real-time visibility into how AI models speak about their brand and products, how competitors show up, and an optimization engine to improve visibility and performance. This category didn’t exist two years ago – we were early, and we’re defining it.

We’re backed by strong investors, trusted by category-leading customers, and scaling fast. We’re hiring curious, ambitious builders to help shape the future of AI search.

**What we’re looking for:**  
You’ll own research from the first question to the published story: run the study, share it, and pitch it to the publications that matter. You are someone who loves digging into data and isn’t waiting to be told what’s next.

You’ll have the support of a team around you, plus the freedom to run your own studies and help our research reach a wider audience. You’ll report to the Director of Growth Marketing, shaping the research roadmap.

**What you’ll do:**

*Run the research*

* Write a one-page study brief before any work starts: the question, hypothesis, data needed, method, and target publish date.
* Define the data set each study needs.
* Request data from our research team, then clean, analyze, and check it.
* Write up what the data shows and what it does not, with a source and date on every number.
* Document each study’s method so the next one is faster.

*Write and publish the findings*

* Turn each study into content for marketing materials, blog, social, email, and other.
* Work with our organic team on drafting and publishing.
* Keep a regular publishing schedule for research across our channels.
* Write research-led pages for the Goodie website, using findings from our studies as proof points so the copy is backed by our own data.

*Pitch the story*

* Write two or three pitch angles per study, each tied to a publication’s recent coverage.
* Build a target list of journalists and editors for every study, and prepare the data and charts they will ask for.
* Send pitches with support from our PR team, and follow up.
* Track every placement, link, and mention in one log.

*Measure and report*

* Set success metrics, a threshold, and a stop date for every study before it publishes.
* Report on each study’s performance from web analytics.
* Recommend what to repeat, change, or stop.

*Beyond the research*

* Contribute to our regular blog publishing, including thought leadership pieces, while studies are in progress, so our publishing rhythm never stalls.
* Prepare content for online and offline events.
* Research competitors and topics to spot gaps that could become your next study.

**What you have:**

* 2+ years experience in marketing, consulting, research, journalism, or analytics.
* Strong writing. You can explain a finding plainly and say clearly what the data cannot support.
* Comfort with data: spreadsheets and the habit of checking numbers before they go out.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) for research, analysis, and drafting, and the judgment to check what they produce before it goes out.
* Curiosity about AI search and how answer engines choose their sources.

**Bonus / nice-to-haves:**

* Experience pitching or working with media, or a clear willingness to learn it.
* Original research that earned media coverage.
* Direct AEO/GEO experience.
