jobs.description:
**IGY SIX Consulting** is recruiting on behalf of **Vertex Security** for a hands-on Bookkeeper & Financial Operations SpecialistAbout the Role

**About the Role**

Vertex Security is seeking a hands-on Bookkeeper & Financial Operations Specialist to take ownership of day-to-day accounts receivable, bookkeeping, financial administration, and related back-office responsibilities.

This is not a narrowly defined accounting position.

Vertex is a growing small business where the person in this role will be expected to manage established financial processes, investigate discrepancies, communicate with customers and vendors, respond to administrative and government correspondence, and independently work through issues that arise during normal business operations.

The right person is organized, resourceful, comfortable making decisions within their area of responsibility, and able to take an issue from identification through resolution without requiring step-by-step direction.

The position reports directly to company leadership and will receive training on Vertex-specific systems, customers, processes, and historical practices during the onboarding period. The expectation is that the successful candidate will progressively take ownership of these responsibilities and become increasingly independent.

**Core ResponsibilitiesAccounts Receivable & Collections**

* Manage the full accounts receivable process from invoice creation through payment and reconciliation.
* Prepare and send customer invoices accurately and on time.
* Monitor aging reports and proactively follow up on outstanding balances.
* Contact customers regarding overdue invoices and resolve payment delays.
* Investigate billing disputes, missing approvals, incorrect balances, and other collection issues.
* Coordinate with project managers and operations teams when billing questions require internal clarification.
* Apply customer payments and reconcile customer accounts.
* Maintain accurate documentation of collection activity, commitments, and follow-up dates.
* Identify accounts requiring escalation and present leadership with the issue, supporting facts, and recommended next step.

**Bookkeeping & Financial Operations**

* Maintain accurate financial records within QuickBooks Online.
* Perform bank and credit-card reconciliations.
* Research and resolve discrepancies between QuickBooks, CRM systems, bank records, and other company systems.
* Support monthly close and ensure required reconciliations and reporting are completed on schedule.
* Assist with sales-tax preparation and other recurring financial requirements.
* Maintain accurate transaction records and supporting documentation.
* Identify discrepancies or unusual activity and investigate the cause before making corrections.
* Support accounts payable responsibilities as the position expands.

**Administrative & Compliance Responsibilities**

* Review and manage company correspondence requiring action or research.
* Respond to notices from government agencies, insurance providers, vendors, customers, and other outside parties.
* Track licenses, registrations, insurance certificates, renewals, and compliance deadlines.
* Research unfamiliar administrative issues and determine the appropriate path toward resolution.
* Maintain organized records and documentation for financial, administrative, insurance, and regulatory matters.
* Coordinate DMV, fleet, insurance, and other general business matters as needed.
* Work with outside professionals such as accountants, insurance representatives, attorneys, or government agencies when appropriate.

**How Success Is Measured**

Success in this role means more than completing assigned tasks.

The person in this position should be able to:

* Maintain accurate and current financial records.
* Keep accounts receivable moving and prevent issues from aging unnecessarily.
* Complete reconciliations and monthly financial processes on schedule.
* Recognize discrepancies and investigate them independently.
* Track deadlines and ensure commitments are not missed.
* Prioritize competing responsibilities based on urgency, financial impact, and risk.
* Communicate problems early rather than allowing them to become emergencies.
* Present leadership with facts and recommended solutions rather than simply passing problems upward.
* Develop systems, checklists, and processes that improve accuracy and efficiency.

**Ideal Background**

* 3+ years of experience in a small-business environment with direct ownership of AP, AR, bookkeeping, or day-to-day financial operations.
* Experience serving as the primary or sole person responsible for core bookkeeping or accounting workflows is strongly preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online.
* Experience managing the full accounts receivable cycle, including invoicing, collections, payment application, aging reports, and reconciliations.
* Experience handling accounts payable, vendor payments, and bank and/or credit-card reconciliations.
* Comfortable working directly with business owners or senior leadership and independently managing day-to-day financial priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to research unfamiliar issues, resolve discrepancies, and bring forward a recommended solution rather than simply escalating the problem.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and competing priorities.
* Comfortable communicating with customers regarding overdue balances, billing disputes, and payment issues.
* Construction, project-based billing, AIA billing, or progress-billing experience is helpful but not required.
* Experience dealing with insurance, government correspondence, licenses, registrations, or similar administrative matters is a plus.

rather than:

We inform. We connect. We create opportunities that turn into deals. Global mindset. Hyper-local execution.  
  
**SUMMARY OF ROLE**  
As a BDR (Business Development Rep) you will be trained in all aspects of the products and solutions that we sell to the commercial real estate market. You will then work with the sales team to create new meetings, proposals and then contracts for clients. Your days will consist of training, taking meetings with clients, attending events to network and learn about our industry. Your goal as an BDR is to ultimately be promoted into a business manager. Once a business manager, you will begin to build your own book of business. If you want to learn how to be a successful business development executive and are willing to work hard and learn, this is a great opportunity for you.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Build and own relationships with marketing decision-makers across all asset classes and sectors in your target markets — this is a relationship-first role.
* Drive sponsorship sales for both digital and in-person events through sharp prospecting research, outreach, and follow-through from first contact to confirmed sponsor.
* Prospect new business daily to build a strong pipeline and develop into an expert at identifying and targeting the right people at the right companies.
* Connect with prospects through phone and email with confidence and creativity — and respond to every inbound lead like it matters, because it does.
* Partner with the event production team to shape sponsor-friendly programs that genuinely align with what our clients care about.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and bring fresh, relevant ideas to the table — the best people here think like journalists and sell like entrepreneurs.
* Know your numbers. Understand individual and team KPIs and show up every day with a plan to hit them — then push past them.
* Keep Salesforce updated and accurate — your pipeline is your business and your documentation reflects how seriously you take it.
* Work closely with a high-energy, cross-functional team to drive sponsorship, marketing, and event performance across the board.

### **What are we looking for?**

* **0–1 years of sales or client-facing experience** — internships, campus jobs, and side hustles count. We care about what you’ve done, not just where.
* **Innate hustle, raw intelligence, and infectious enthusiasm** — you’re the person who finds a way, not a reason. You make the room more energetic just by being in it.
* **Entrepreneurial but disciplined** — you think like an owner and execute like a professional. Creative enough to find new angles, organized enough to follow through.
* **A fast learner who stays curious** — we’re constantly bringing new digital and event products to market. You’ll need to understand them, believe in them, and sell them. If you love learning how things work, you’ll thrive here.
* **A proven team player** — athletics, clubs, Greek life, group projects, volunteer work — show us a moment where you elevated the people around you.
* **Hungry to be client-facing** — this role is your launchpad into an externally facing sales career. You should be excited about that, not just open to it.
* **Genuinely curious about commercial real estate, media, and digital marketing** — you don’t need to know the industry cold, but you should want to. Our best people become obsessed with the space they cover.
* **Coachable above all else** — you welcome feedback, act on it fast, and don’t take it personally. The best salespeople in this building got there because they listened.
* **Built for a fast-paced environment** — things move quickly here and priorities shift. You stay focused, adapt without drama, and bring energy on the hard days too.

### **What's in it for you?**

* Competitive compensation structure
* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
* Maternity and paternity leaves
* 401K
* Flexible Spending Account
* Dependent Care Account
* Health Savings Account
* **Unlimited Vacation Days**
* 7 days paid sick leave
* 9 paid Holidays
* Referral Bonus Program
* You’ll get to work with incredibly smart, passionate, driven, ambitious, kind, caring and mindful people and will rarely experience an overload of policies, bureaucracy or toxicity (the latter, we do not tolerate).

Uncapped monthly bonuses tied to a performance-based step scale: the more you close, the more you earn.

Anticipated start date: July 6th, 2027

jobs.title: TH Operations Coordinator I (DOO)
jobs.description:
Overview:

**Operations Coordinator I**

**Non-Profit Supervisors Can Work Anywhere….The BEST Work with Us!**

**Salary: $68,959**

A nationally recognized comprehensive Health and Human Services Agency, with over 60 programs across New York City and the greater New York Area.

Samaritan Daytop Village serves over 33,000 New Yorkers annually within your neighborhoods and communities so our success depends on those we employ.

**The Role**

The Operations Coordinator I, is responsible for ensuring the safe and efficient operations of an agency Shelter site by managing and monitoring administrative, fiscal, food services, physical plant safety and security, and transportation systems. This position supports a positive environment of care for persons served by ensuring a clean, hazard-free, and supportive environment for the effective delivery of quality services. In addition, this position supervises the program operation team and provides support to the social service director and staff. This work is carried out in support of the mission and goals of Samaritan Daytop Village.

**\*\*Please Note: Candidates Must have FDNY F-80- Certificate of Fitness for Coordinator of Fire Safety and Alarm Systems.\*\***

Responsibilities:

**What You Will Do**

* Ensures program adherence to Federal, State, and NYC Department of Homeless Service regulatory guidelines governing physical plant and fire/safety management.
* Manages and monitors program environment to ensure that regulatory guidelines and agency safety/security policies are followed and interpersonal and professional relationships remain positive.
* Manages and monitors daily operations, vehicle/transportation systems and client metro-card distribution, fire drills, children's school attendance and all building front desk activities. Maintain compliance with Health, Safety, and Risk Management Manual. Supervises onsite security guards, and visiting service providers for clients and agencies.
* Ensures all shelter units meet DHS and OTDA standards upon the client’s admission and shelter stay. Manage and update critical files as needed.
* Maintains program census and the status of all shelter units by monitoring client attendance, pass control, and the sign In and Out sheets and nightly roster. Ensures each family signs the nightly roster and their attendance is recorded in DHS Cares daily. Plus assists budget dept. with monthly reconciliation with Cares.
* Reviews and approves staff time cards and vacation requests by agency’s deadlines.
* Maintains adequate staff coverage at the assigned facility.

Qualifications:

**Who You Will Be**

* Someone who has a High School diploma or Equivalent.
* At least Three (3) years of related management experience supervising staff in shelter/transitional or permanent supportive housing and experience working with the NYC Department of Homeless Services (DHS) or other similar city-operated organizations.
* FDNY F-80 Certificate of Fitness for Coordinator of Fire Safety and Alarm Systems
* Ability to implement and monitor policy and procedure in accordance with agency guidelines.
* Knowledge of NYC Department of Homeless Services regulations of physical plant management, food services management, and fire safety management

jobs.title: Ice Operations Coordinator - Davis Center at the Harlem Meer
jobs.description:
**ICE OPERATIONS COORDINATOR - Davis Center at the Harlem Meer**

**HAR SFM, LLC**

*LOCATION: New York, New York*

**DEPARTMENT: OPERATIONS**

**REPORTS TO: GENERAL MANAGER**

**STATUS: FULL-TIME (EXEMPT)**

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

Davis Center at the Harlem Meer is a brand new state-of-the-art recreational facility in New York City's iconic Central Park featuring a 1.25 acre outdoor area which houses an elliptical pool (280' x 120') that converts to a .75 acre public green during the spring & fall and features a full-size ice rink in the winter months. A 34,000 sq ft adjacent building houses locker rooms, public restrooms, and a large indoor gathering space to support all outdoor programming. Described by Manhattan Borough President Mark Levine as "one of the most important parks equity projects for the City in decades", the new Davis Center is the capstone project of the Central Park Conservancy's 40-year effort to restore Central Park and will serve as the hub for recreational and community programming in the area. You will be joining a championship level team focused on fun, fulfillment and service built to enrich the community as well as your career and personal growth.

Davis Center at the Harlem Meer is a managed facility by HAR SFM, LLC, a Sports Facilities Companies (SFC) company. SFC is the nation's leading resource for managing and developing sports, recreation, wellness, and events facilities. We provide a highly collaborative and supportive culture that raises our team members to new levels of career growth. Together, we will carve a path in a hyper- growing industry where you will enjoy the journey and learn from the industry's best while having some fun.

SFC has been awarded national recognition as a Top Workplace and is considered a workplace of choice. Our mission-focused company is highly entrepreneurial, team-oriented with a culture centered on collaboration, accountability, excellence, and service. We are growing rapidly and looking for high performers at every level to grow with us.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Ice Operations Coordinator will work in coordination with the General Manager to support the overall management and maintenance of the facility. This position provides direction and training to front-line supervisors and part-time team members. This role will work closely with individual leaders of each program as well as other internal departments to successfully accomplish these responsibilities.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO THE FOLLOWING:**

* Provides support to front-line managers/supervisors to promote compliance with SFM policies and additional applicable laws
* Assist in coordinating daily operations of the ice venue, including ice maintenance, scheduling, and facility operations
* Supports the training and day-to-day guidance of ice resurfacer operators to ensure a safe, skateable ice surface and adherence to operational standards
* Ensure the ice surface is properly maintained, including ice resurfacing, checking for quality, and addressing any issues promptly
* Coordinate the setup and teardown of events, including hockey games, public skating sessions, and private rentals
* Coordinate communications with event or rental owners pre and post event
* Participates in planning/strategic meetings
* Conduct regular inspections of the facility to ensure cleanliness, safety, and compliance with health and safety regulations
* Coordinate with Maintenance Team Members to address any repairs or upgrades needed for the facility and equipment
* Support proper cash handling procedures
* Supports hiring, training, and education of Team Members on proper safety procedures
* Monitors team schedule
* Assists in maintaining budgets, and exercises control in expense management and facility maintenance
* Promotes company culture and expectations to Team Members
* Oversees proper reporting of inventory
* Serves as MOD as needed
* All additional tasks assigned by management

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 3+ years of experience as an ice resurfacer operator required
* 2+ years of experience in a leadership role in operational management required
* 1 or more years of facility maintenance experience preferred
* Certified Ice Technician (CIT) preferred
* Must be willing to obtain Fire Guard Certification if requested
* Must have excellent interpersonal, project management and problem-solving skills
* Must be a team player
* Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Must have excellent computer skills, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.
* Must be able to work flexible schedules including weekends, nights, and holidays
* Well organized, efficient, flexible, and able to meet deadlines
* Able to cope with many tasks at once and work to tight schedules
* Must possess current CPR/FIRST AID certifications or must be willing to obtain them within a specified period of time

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

* Will be required to sit or stand for extended periods of time
* Must be able to lift 50 pounds waist high
* Must be able to work in cold and inclement weather for prolonged periods of time
* May be required to squat, stoop or bend

jobs.description:

As a Camera Operator/Production Assistant, you’ll help bring stories to life from setup through post-production. You’ll prepare cameras, microphones, and lighting; capture polished video and photography; and support audio and video processing and editing. Your impact: By capturing clear, compelling footage and sound, you help audiences connect with the story and give production teams reliable material to shape into finished content.

* Set up, operate, and maintain cameras, video recording equipment, microphones, and lighting for video production.
* Film and photograph interviews, events, and other assigned content, applying visual storytelling principles.

* Organize footage and support post-production, including video editing and media preparation.

**Requirements**

* Demonstrated technical proficiency with camera setup, filming, videography, photography, and sound recording for video production.
* Familiarity with video production workflows, post-production, and media editing tools.
* Experience with Adobe Premiere or Final Cut Pro is preferred; knowledge of Adobe After Effects and Adobe Creative Suite is also valued.
* Familiarity with Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Lightroom is a plus.
* Clear communication, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate with production teams.

Pay: From $20.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10010

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager (Design and Construction)
jobs.description:
Brailsford & Dunlavey (B&D), which now includes Project Management Advisors (PMA), is seeking an Assistant Project Manager to support complex healthcare design and construction projects across the New York region. This is an opportunity for a driven, collaborative professional who enjoys solving problems, building relationships, and contributing to projects that directly impact healthcare environments and patient care.

Located in New York, NY, on a hybrid basis.

**The Opportunity**

At Brailsford & Dunlavey (B&D), we lead the planning, development, and management of the places that shape and strengthen communities—where people live, learn, work, and play. B&D partners with institutions, municipalities, and organizations to shape and deliver complex real estate and capital projects, providing strategic insight and end-to-end advisory services across the full project lifecycle.

B&D recently joined forces with Project Management Advisors, bringing together two nationally recognized leaders in program management and real estate advisory services. Together, the combined firm offers expanded capabilities across industries and throughout the full project lifecycle—from early-stage strategy and planning through execution and beyond.

Our healthcare project management team partners with clients to guide complex projects through planning, design, construction, and occupancy. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being highly engaged with clients and project teams, thrives in fast-moving environments, and wants to continue developing professionally while taking on meaningful responsibility.

As an Assistant Project Manager, you will support healthcare projects from pre-construction through closeout, collaborating closely with senior project leaders, clients, architects, engineers, consultants, and contractors to ensure successful project execution.

**How You’ll Contribute**

* Support the planning, coordination, and execution of healthcare design and construction projects across multiple phases
* Assist with project-specific tasks to help meet client goals, schedules, budgets, and contractual obligations
* Support pre-construction planning activities, conceptual design analysis, and project documentation efforts
* Coordinate and review architectural and engineering drawings, bid documents, and consultant deliverables
* Assist with contract administration activities and support the preparation of contracts, addenda, and project documentation
* Help manage permitting coordination and support project teams through regulatory approval processes
* Participate in meetings with clients, architects, engineers, contractors, and consultants to review project progress and resolve issues
* Maintain project tracking logs, open item lists, schedules, and budget documentation
* Monitor project budgets and schedules, including maintaining web-based project controls and reporting tools
* Observe construction progress and document field conditions, project updates, and safety-related observations
* Support project closeout activities and transition planning efforts
* Contribute to a collaborative team environment focused on problem-solving, accountability, and client service excellence

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in architecture, engineering, construction management, or a related field
* 3+ years of project management or project coordination experience within healthcare design, construction, or related environments
* Understanding of design and construction processes, project controls, and consultant coordination
* Familiarity with construction documentation, budgeting, scheduling, and contract administration
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint
* You operate with a high level of personal integrity
* Ability to work collaboratively while also taking ownership of assigned responsibilities
* Professionalism, adaptability, positivity, and a strong client-service mindset

**What Sets You Apart**

This role is ideal for someone who wants to grow beyond basic project coordination and become a trusted contributor within complex healthcare environments. You are proactive, positive, organized, and energized by working closely with clients and project teams to move projects forward.

You communicate confidently, build strong working relationships, and bring a high level of accountability to your work. You are intellectually curious, eager to learn, and motivated by opportunities to take on increasing responsibility and professional growth within a collaborative advisory environment.

Impactful Mission  
Be part of meaningful work that helps shape the places where people live, learn, heal, work, and connect.

We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning at every stage of your career.

Strong Culture  
Entrepreneurial thinking, collaboration, intellectual curiosity, integrity, and excellence drive how we work together.

Comprehensive benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement benefits, professional development support, paid time off, and more.

An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. *For more information, go to* *med.nyu.edu*, and interact with us on *LinkedIn*, *Glassdoor*, *Indeed*, *Facebook*, *X* *and* *Instagram*.

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as an Executive Assistant to Chair.
  
  
In this role, the successful candidate reports to the Department Administrator and the Chairman, the Ex. Assistant is responsible for providing executive support to the Chair and Administrator of the Department of Neurosurgery. Other responsibilities include day-to-day management and strategic support in the areas of general administration, human resources, staff liaison, purchasing/accounts payables as needed, events planning and coordination, and general office and programmatic support.

jobs.title: Inventory & Purchasing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the role:**

You will own our inventory from the shelf to the purchase order: knowing what we have, where it is, and what we need next. You will also be the first stop for purchase requests, researching products and suppliers so the team buys the right item at a fair price.

This role suits someone who likes putting things in order and keeping them that way, and who enjoys digging into specs, prices and lead times before recommending a purchase.

**Inventory management and organization**

* Keep accurate counts of parts, materials, tools and supplies in our inventory system.
* Receive incoming shipments, check them against the purchase order, and report shortages or damage.
* Label, bin and shelve items so anyone on the team can find them without asking.
* Design and maintain the storage layout, including bin locations and naming conventions.
* Run regular cycle counts and a full physical count on a set schedule, and resolve discrepancies.
* Set and monitor minimum stock levels, and flag items before they run out.
* Track tools and equipment that are checked out, and follow up on returns.
* Identify obsolete, excess or damaged stock and recommend what to do with it.
* Keep storage areas clean, safe and orderly.

**Purchase requests and research**

* Take in purchase requests from the team and clarify what is needed, by when, and why.
* Research options: compare specifications, price, availability, lead time, shipping cost and supplier reliability.
* Request and compare quotes from multiple vendors.
* Present a short recommendation with the options considered, so the approver can decide quickly.
* Create purchase orders once approved, and track them through delivery.
* Follow up with suppliers on late, incorrect or incomplete orders, and handle returns.
* Maintain vendor records, including contacts, pricing, terms and past performance.
* Look for savings through alternate sources, bulk pricing or substitutions that meet the same need.
* Match receipts to purchase orders so accounting can pay vendor bills without delay.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 2+ years in inventory control, purchasing, warehouse, stockroom or a similar role.
* Strong organizational habits and attention to detail; your counts are right.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets and with learning inventory or ERP software.
* Able to research unfamiliar products and summarize the options clearly in writing.
* Clear, professional communication with coworkers and suppliers.
* Able to work independently and follow through without reminders.
* Able to lift up to [50] lb and spend part of the day on your feet.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Odoo or another ERP system.
* Experience buying industrial, mechanical or electrical parts and reading spec sheets or drawings.
* Experience negotiating with vendors or arranging freight.
* Forklift certification.
* Barcode or label system setup experience.

Pay: $28.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k) 3% Match
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

As part of customer onboarding and management, you will uncover opportunities, often by discovering customer problems, and will act as the liaison between Swift’s technical team and each customer to solve problems an ensure an awesome (!) experience.

**2.** Develop, discover and attend community events in order to promote coverage options and the mission and services of the organization.

**3.** Collaborate with various local organizations to build awareness of coverage options, spur enrollment and build referral linkages.

**4.** Disseminate health center information at different community events, local businesses, community-based organizations and other healthcare providers.

**8.** Acquire and maintain Certified Application Counselor (CAC) certification.

**9.** Communicate with AHSFHC uninsured patients to assess their needs and enroll them in state Application for Benefit Eligibility (ABE) or ACA Marketplace.

**10.** Provide enrollment assistance (including but not limited to completing coverage applications, gathering required documentation and troubleshooting the enrollment process) for uninsured children and adults to access subsidized, low-cost and free health insurance programs through the health insurance marketplace, Medicaid and the All Kids program.

**11.** Provide structured patient education on health coverage, engage in follow-up conversations and offer renewal assistance for enrolled individuals.

**12.** Attend and successfully complete all required training programs; participate in ongoing conference calls, webinars/seminars and other professional development opportunities.

**13.** Accurately provide required reporting to track goal achievement and client satisfaction.

**14.** In collaboration with the supervisor recruit and utilize volunteers to increase program capacity.

**15.** Assist in the development and implementation of organizational outreach and enrollment initiatives.

**16.** Work with the AHSFHC management to overall increase and optimize health center productivity utilizing O&E activities.

**17.** Meet with supervisor on weekly basis and report all activities to the clinic director

**18.** Expectations: A minimum of 700 individuals to be enrolled in a given twelve month period.

The Community Outreach Services Coordinator performs duties to support and grow PAWS Chicago outreach program operations, specifically spay/neuter access initiatives, Community Cats, Community Medicine, Pet Food Pantry, and 360 @ CACC. The primary purpose of this role is to ensure all outreach services are being effectively delivered to target area clients. Services include Trap-Neuter-Return (TNR), spay/neuter, information on pet wellness, and veterinary resources.

  

Daily duties include, but are not limited to, spay/neuter transports, TNR field days and trap deliveries, working with volunteers during outreach and TNR efforts, program administration, and on-site program support at Chicago Animal Care and Control (CACC). The Community Outreach Services Coordinator also plays a key role in engaging pet owners in underserved areas of Chicago. This position is based at PAWS Medical Center, but the Community Outreach Services Coordinator travels and works in targeted Chicago communities as well.

jobs.title: Account Manager (Manufactuing Technology)
jobs.description:
**About Teeptrak**
------------------

Teeptrak is a worldwide leader in providing manufacturing monitoring solutions, specializing in turnkey digital solutions that enable factories to optimize performance in a cost-effective, innovative way. As we expand our footprint in the U.S., we are growing our commercial team and are looking for an Account Manager to turn qualified opportunities into lasting customer relationships.

**About the Role**
------------------

As an Account Manager at Teeptrak, you will own the meetings that move prospects to customers. Our Business Development Representatives book qualified meetings, and you take it from there: you run discovery and follow-up meetings, coordinate demos with our Sales Engineers, build proposals, and close new business. Once a customer is live, you stay their main commercial contact and grow the account across lines, plants and sites.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable leading a conversation with a plant manager, an operations director or a CFO, and who can keep a full calendar of meetings organized and moving forward.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Meeting Ownership: Run discovery, follow-up and decision meetings with prospects booked by the BDR team, both virtually and on-site at customer facilities.
* Discovery & Qualification: Understand each plant's production challenges, current tools and goals, and identify the stakeholders involved in the buying decision.
* Sales Cycle Management: Move opportunities from first meeting through pilot, proposal, negotiation and signature.
* Demo Coordination: Work with Sales Engineers to prepare and deliver product demos and pilots tailored to each customer's operations.
* Proposals & Negotiation: Build proposals and quotes, present pricing, and negotiate terms with customers.
* Account Growth: Own a portfolio of customer accounts after signature, hold regular business reviews, and identify expansion opportunities to new lines, plants and Teeptrak products.
* Customer Relationships: Act as the main commercial contact for your accounts and work with customer success and support to keep customers satisfied.
* CRM Management: Keep meetings, notes, pipeline stages and forecasts accurate and up to date in our CRM.
* BDR Collaboration: Give feedback to the BDR team on meeting quality and target accounts to improve the pipeline.
* Market Feedback: Share customer insights with the sales, marketing and product teams to shape Teeptrak's U.S. strategy.

  
**Requirements**

**Who You Are**
---------------

* A confident meeting leader who can guide a conversation, ask the right questions and agree on clear next steps.
* Comfortable speaking with operators, engineers and executive leadership.
* Highly organized, able to manage a full calendar and many opportunities at once.
* Able to understand technical products and explain their business value in a clear way.
* Self-motivated, results-driven and coachable.
* A team player who works well with BDRs, Sales Engineers and customer success.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 2+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management or account executive roles.
* A track record of running meetings, managing a pipeline and closing deals.
* Strong verbal, written and presentation skills.
* Experience with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, Odoo, HubSpot).
* Willingness to travel to customer facilities.

**Bonus If You Have**
---------------------

* Experience selling to manufacturing or industrial companies.
* Familiarity with OEE, MES or production monitoring systems.
* Experience in SaaS or industrial technology sales.
* Experience managing multi-site or enterprise accounts.

  
**Benefits**

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base salary with commission and performance-based incentives
* Growth potential as we expand in the U.S.
* Direct impact on a fast-growing U.S. business
* 401(k)
* Unlimited PTO
* Paid sick days and holidays
* Hybrid work schedule
* Health, dental and vision insurance

**Teeptrak is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
---------------------------------------------

At Teeptrak, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable work environment where all individuals can thrive. We believe that diversity strengthens our team and contributes to our success. We are dedicated to offering all candidates a fair, accessible and inclusive experience throughout the hiring process, regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Teeptrak, we encourage you to embrace your authentic self and share what makes you unique.

jobs.title: Client Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About The Opportunity**

The Corporate team works with a wide range of companies and industries to support their meal programs. The Client Success Team is responsible for maintaining and growing clients sold in by Sales. There is a significant upselling component to the Client Success Manager role, while ensuring client satisfaction and continued growth with Grubhub's offerings.

As a Client Success Manager, you will be responsible for growing and managing a portfolio of corporate clients. Your primary focus will be the growth and retention of your clients, while fostering strong relationships with key stakeholders and understanding their business needs.

**The Impact You Will Make**

* Accelerate growth and retain revenue through upselling and day-to-day account management.
* Understand and achieve upsell and client meeting KPIs to drive growth in the corporate business segment.
* Track and report on key client metrics, including engagement, satisfaction, and revenue.
* Work with clients to quantify opportunities and create solutions to ensure a positive client experience.
* Consistently materialize closed-won upsell opportunities into realized revenue.
* Partner with Sales for new client launches and opportunities within existing business.
* Engage in informal and formal client meetings, at times with travel and in-person meetings, to foster strong client relationships and seek out ultimate decision-makers. Present to senior-level client leaders to advocate for program results and propose expansion opportunities.
* Understand the client’s business and provide tailored recommendations.
* Act as an advocate for clients within Grubhub internally by providing feedback to relevant teams and escalating issues to a manager as needed.
* Prioritize work on the highest impact areas within a book of business.
* Handle contract negotiations and use contractual terms adjustments to deepen client relationships.
* Serve as a customer-facing product expert, educating clients about features and benefits to maximize the value they get from the Grubhub corporate platform.
* Troubleshoot and resolve client concerns effectively, delegating tasks to internal teams as needed.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Product, and Support, to address client needs and improve the overall client experience.

**What You Bring to the Table**

* 3+ years of experience in a quota bearing B2B Account Management, Sales, or Client Success role working with a range of clients and industries.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* Experience upselling or cross-selling existing business to achieve a quota or growth metric.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with a professional demeanor.
* Strong problem-solving and multitasking abilities in a fast-paced setting.
* Ability to work cross-functionally and influence without direct authority.
* Experience in client education, product support, and building trust with stakeholders.
* Passion to partner with Sales to optimize the client journey and lifetime revenue.
* Ability to analyze trends and patterns to identify opportunities within your book of business.
* Ability to navigate high stress situations and de-escalate client complaints; judgment to escalate to managers to help resolve critical issues
* Strong organizational skills and high attention to detail.
* Technical competence and an aptitude for learning new systems.
* Working knowledge of CRM systems (Salesforce is a plus).
* Ability to attend in-person client meetings and some travel may be required.

Our hybrid model requires 3 days a week in the office. That said, many team members choose to come in more often to take advantage of in-person collaboration and connection. You're welcome—and encouraged—to be in the office up to 5 days a week if it works for you.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative

At Xenon arc, we’re transforming how producers connect with their customers.

We partner with leading companies—ranging from industrial chemical manufacturers to global food ingredient providers—to solve complex challenges in reaching and serving hard-to-access markets. By acting as an extension of our clients' brands, we help them grow sales, optimize operations, and embrace digital transformation.

Our teams bring technical expertise, innovative digital tools, and a customer-focused approach to drive exceptional results. We don’t just distribute products—we create solutions that strengthen client-customer relationships and build lasting success.

jobs.title: Associate Client Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About The Opportunity**

The Client Success team in Corporate Accounts works with SMB and Enterprise organizations who have Grubhub meal programs for their employees. CSMs assist their clients in platform onboarding, then facilitate and grow their corporate meal program which can include individual orders, group orders, catering, and event based services. CSMs are experts on the corporate program and upsell their client accounts through expanding the budget, adding office locations or business segments, and other use cases from what Sales initially sells. They continuously work to identify account growth opportunities through maintaining strong relationships and keeping their clients informed of product changes and promotions.

The Associate level CSM owns upselling on lower spending accounts which have huge upsell potential, as many large organizations begin with a conservative test budget then expand into 6 and 7 figures.

**The Impact You Will Make**

* Own a book of business and associated revenue objectives for several hundred clients which will have varying activity: a portion of the book will be “always-on,” some seasonal and one-time events.
* Prioritize your book of business, in partnership with the team manager, to ensure time and effort are focused on the most impactful areas.
* Identify revenue upsell and cross-sell opportunities through maintaining good client relationships, doing frequent discovery and alerting clients to promotions and special offers.
* Partner with the sales team to ensure the successful onboarding of new business, engaging with customer stakeholders to quickly understand their goals to set up the account for success over time
* Complete initial Corporate product and site training for new clients and retrain admins as needed for contact turnover and expansion. Leverage self-guided training videos to optimize time spent.
* Monitor client performance, address open issues including order issue triage, and in times of client dissatisfaction, work with manager to resolve
* Check in with clients for day to day management using email, virtual meetings and calls
* Log activities in Salesforce, including attaching email communication, submitting opportunities, and flagging risk scenarios via risk cases. Keep opportunities up to date with accurate data and upsell values
* Meet KPIs, as designated by team manager, including but not limited to client meetings, upsell opportunities and client engagement.
* Own contract renewal process, with manager support, including contract negotiation to meet Grubhub and client financial objectives
* Maintain good product knowledge of existing and new features and functionality
* Liaise with other departments such as Marketing, Operations, Product, Finance, Revenue Ops, and others to determine the best solution to client needs, communicate feedback and relay trends
* Cover and support team members as needed for out of office periods

**What You Bring to the Table**

* Bachelor's degree preferred
* 1-3 years of experience in a B2B Account Management, Sales, or Client Success role
* Experience upselling or cross-selling new and existing business to achieve a quota or growth metric
* Ability to analyze trends, data, and patterns to identify opportunities within your book of business
* Passion to partner with Sales to optimize the new client journey and lifetime revenue
* Good communication and high attention to detail
* Ability to navigate high-stress situations, with manager support as needed, to de-escalate and resolve client complaints
* Ability to effectively work with cross-functional internal teams
* Technical competence and an aptitude for learning new systems. Experience with Google Suite and Client Success tools (ChurnZero, Gainsight, Salesforce) is a plus
* Comfort learning to collaborate with others, open to and willing to quickly implement feedback and learnings from teammates
* Open to rapid change and ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Some travel may be required

Our hybrid model requires 3 days a week in the office. That said, many team members choose to come in more often to take advantage of in-person collaboration and connection. You're welcome—and encouraged—to be in the office up to 5 days a week if it works for you.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Teeptrak**  
Teeptrak is a worldwide leader in providing manufacturing monitoring solutions, specializing in turnkey digital solutions that enable factories to optimize performance in a cost-effective, innovative way. As we expand our footprint into the U.S., we are looking to scale our team and are seeking an enthusiastic and results-driven Sales Development Representative to help drive our growth in the U.S. market.

**Position Overview**  
As a Sales Development Representative (BDR) at Teeptrak, you’ll play a key role in spearheading our U.S. market expansion. You will be responsible for generating high-quality leads, qualifying prospects, and setting up meetings with potential clients. Your work will lay the foundation for successful sales engagements, introducing Teeptrak’s innovative solutions to manufacturing companies, and contributing to sustainable long-term growth in the U.S.

**Job Description**  
Responsibilities:

* Lead Generation: Proactively generate high-quality leads through outreach via phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels to build a strong sales pipeline.
* Pipeline Development: Research and qualify prospects, identify key decision-makers, and nurture relationships to build a sustainable pipeline for the sales team.
* Sales Collaboration: Work closely with the sales and marketing teams to schedule meetings, demos, and follow-ups with qualified prospects, contributing to Teeptrak’s overall growth strategy in the U.S.
* Strategic Contribution: Provide valuable insights to shape and implement sales strategies that align with Teeptrak’s long-term vision for success in the U.S. market.
* CRM Management: Maintain accurate records of interactions, progress, and key performance indicators (KPIs) in our CRM system, ensuring data integrity for ongoing strategic planning.
* Value Proposition Demonstration: Effectively communicate Teeptrak’s unique value proposition to potential clients, addressing questions, overcoming objections, and building trust.
* Team Growth & Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to the team’s growth by sharing insights, best practices, and continuously enhancing your understanding of Teeptrak’s solutions.
* Adaptability: Demonstrate flexibility to adjust quickly to evolving market conditions, responsibilities, and priorities as Teeptrak’s presence grows in the U.S.
* Product Knowledge: Continuously enhance your understanding of Teeptrak’s products and the manufacturing industry to better position our solutions and provide more value to prospects.

  
**Requirements**

**Required Experience**  
Education:

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.

Work Experience:

* At least 1+ years of experience in sales or as a Sales Development Representative (SDR), preferably in a B2B environment, and a demonstrated interest in the manufacturing or technology sectors.

Skills:

* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage prospects and clearly articulate Teeptrak’s value proposition.
* Technical Learning: Ability to quickly understand and communicate technical concepts and products in a relatable way to prospects.
* Adaptability: Thrive in a fast-paced environment with the ability to manage multiple priorities and shifting responsibilities.
* Resilience: Strong passion for sales and personal growth, with the resilience to overcome challenges and push through obstacles.
* Self-Motivation: Highly organized and self-driven, with excellent time management skills.
* Independence & Teamwork: Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team setting.
* Coachable: Willingness to learn, grow, and accept constructive feedback to improve performance.
* Problem-Solving: Creative in overcoming challenges and identifying solutions that benefit both the company and the customer.

**Preferred Job Requirements:**

* Previous experience in the manufacturing or technology sector.
* Familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce).
* Experience with outreach and sales tools (e.g., LinkedIn Sales Navigator, outreach platforms).

  
**Benefits**

**What We Offer:**

At TeepTrak, we believe in working hard AND enjoying life! That’s why we offer awesome benefits like:

* Competitive salary with performance-based incentives and commission opportunities
* Growth potential as we expand in the U.S.
* Collaborative environment where your contributions directly impact our success
* 401(k) for your future
* Unlimited PTO—take time when you need it, no limits!
* Paid sick days & holidays—because everyone deserves a break
* Hybrid work schedule—some days in the office, others from home
* Health, dental, and vision insurance to keep you covered

Join us and be part of a team where your growth and success matter!

Teeptrak is an Equal Opportunity Employer  
At Teeptrak, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable work environment where all individuals can thrive. We believe that diversity strengthens our team and contributes to our success. We are dedicated to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience throughout the hiring process, regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Teeptrak, we encourage you to embrace your authentic self and share what makes you unique.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Aiphone Corporation is looking for a Regional Sales Representative in Milwaukee, WI or Chicago, IL. We offer a competitive base salary and benefits package. This position is eligible for commission and quarterly bonuses.**

### **About the Position**

Responsible for assisting in the sales of the company’s products throughout a defined geographical region, industry, or product line.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** include the following. Other duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

* Achieves quarterly and annual goals assigned by Director of Sales, including but not limited to, regional sales quotas, new product sales, customer training, and strategic account management.
* Assists in managing the company’s relationships with all local, regional, and national accounts.
* Assists distributors and dealers with the development of new business opportunities.
* Helps develop short- and long-range sales objectives, plans strategies for attainment, and develops sales performance standards for measuring progress.

**Additional Responsibilities** include the following.

* Reports progress towards assigned goals to Director of Sales.
* Conducts training classes, both technical and sales, for various accounts.
* Compiles and analyzes sales data.
* Uses company resources and self-training techniques to learn company sales and marketing goals and strategies; product information including technical and application; effective use of account management and presentation tools.
* Maintains and updates customer database.

**Inter-relationship** Relationship of position with internal, lateral, and external groups.

Interacts with co-workers as a team member. Works closely with marketing team, other field sales managers, department managers, and senior/executive management. Works closely with sales representatives. May work closely with existing and prospective customer accounts.

**Physical Demands:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. The employee is regularly required to sit for long periods of time; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; balance; bend and reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. Occasionally required to climb ladders, stand, stoop, kneel, squat, crouch, or crawl. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**Work Environment:**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. For the most part, ambient room temperatures, lighting and traditional office equipment as found in a typical office environment. Position requires working out of a home office and includes travel up to 50% to various company, industry, and customer related events on an international, national, regional, or local basis.

**GENEROUS BENEFITS:**

* Base salary with guaranteed bonus and performance bonus potential
* Health benefits
* Generous 401K match
* Additional benefits

### **Position requirements**

*The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**Education and Related Experience:**

* Typically requires an associate degree or equivalent and knowledge of, and/or experience in the sales of product within the industry, or product segment.
* Requires a minimum 2 years of sales management experience.
* Experience in business-to-business, channel and consumer marketing preferred.

**REQUIRED COMPETENCIES:** To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of:

* Excellent written, oral communication and presentation skills required. Must have strong problem-solving skills and communicate persuasively.
* Proficient in Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and SharePoint) with knowledge of standard CRM Database package and other software programs used within the company.
* Steady paced, able to work consistently with many distractions. Must be able to work within a team and independently. Must be able to maintain an organized schedule with competing priorities, executing plans within scheduled deadlines.
* Good analytical ability with a high degree of accuracy.
* Acts in ethical and professional manner at all times with colleagues, customers, and vendors, representing the highest standards of Aiphone behavior.
* Fosters an inclusive workplace where diversity and individual differences are valued and leveraged to achieve the vision and mission of the organization.
* Is open to change and new information; adapts behavior or work methods in response to new information, changing conditions, or unexpected obstacles; effectively deals with ambiguity.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
At Mintel, we help businesses understand people, markets, and what comes next. As a global market intelligence agency, our understanding of consumers, innovation, and industry gives clients the clarity to act and the confidence to lead. With more than 50 years of expertise, we combine the real-world understanding of our experts with advanced technology to uncover patterns, anticipate change, and help organizations make smarter decisions.

Our Business Development team focuses on expanding our client base in the Consumer Packaged Goods and Professional Services sectors. This individual will join a very successful team that serves as an integral part of Mintel's business and will get the opportunity to partner with some of the key players in these industries. You must be a highly motivated individual with a positive, can-do approach to problem-solving and ideally have one year of sales or sales support experience.

**This is a Hybrid position based in Chicago.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build pipeline by researching and contacting prospects through phone, email, LinkedIn, CRM data, ZoomInfo, Sales Navigator, and other approved channels
* Serve as the first point of contact for assigned inbound marketing leads and qualify opportunities against agreed criteria
* Identify decision-makers in marketing, research, and consumer insights functions and uncover their business needs through effective discovery questions
* Secure introductory meetings and hand qualified opportunities to the Business Development Sales team
* Maintain accurate, timely records of prospect activity, conversations, qualification details, and next steps in the CRM
* Share prospect feedback and market insights with Sales, Marketing, and leadership
* Develop practical knowledge of Mintel's solutions and the CPG and Professional Services sectors

**Required Qualifications:**

* At least 1 year of experience in sales, business development, sales support, customer service, or another relevant client-facing role
* Confidence making cold and warm introductions by phone, email, and LinkedIn
* Strong written and verbal communication, active listening, and consultative questioning skills
* A self-directed and organized approach, with the ability to manage a high volume of prospects and competing priorities
* Resilience, sound judgment, curiosity, and a positive approach to feedback and rejection
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced sales environment

**Preferred Experience:**

* Outbound prospecting, lead generation, or lead qualification
* Using a CRM and sales intelligence tools such as ZoomInfo or LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Exposure to CPG, Professional Services, marketing, market research, or consumer insights

Alongside salary, Mintel offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical/dental/vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, employer paid life and disability insurance, 401(k) with employer match and paid time off. jobs.title: Home Health Marketing & Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Silver Lining provides behavioral health, daily living assistance, and skilled home healthcare services to support individuals and families. Its mission is to help people live healthier, happier, and more connected lives.

**Job Overview**

As a Home Health Marketing & Business Development Representative, you’ll build referral relationships and grow awareness of Silver Lining’s home healthcare services. You’ll manage a territory, connect with healthcare and community partners, and guide prospective clients through clear, responsive communication.

This position is paid through a combination of **base salary and bonus**. The base salary provides steady, predictable income, and performance bonuses reward you directly for the referral relationships you build and the new patient admissions they bring in. The more your territory grows, the more you earn.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop new business through outside and field sales, B2B outreach, enterprise selling, and account management.
* Build customer relationships with referral partners; explain services, deliver product demos, and respond to client needs.
* Manage the sales pipeline and territory, use analysis to identify opportunities, negotiate terms, and close deals.
* Track activity in a customer relationship management (CRM) system and communicate progress toward sales goals.
* Your impact: Strong partner relationships help individuals and families learn about home healthcare options and connect with services suited to their needs.

**Requirements**

* **Key Responsibilities**

Business Development & Relationship Management

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with hospitals, rehabilitation centers, physician offices, senior housing communities, assisted living facilities, skilled nursing facilities, case managers, social workers, discharge planners, and relevant community organizations.
* Conduct routine in-person visits to referral sources within the assigned territory.
* Identify, develop, and secure new referral opportunities to increase service volume.
* Maintain a consistent outreach schedule and document all activities in company tracking systems/CRM.
* Represent Silver Lining at networking events, health fairs, senior expos, community meetings, and industry functions.
* Deliver marketing materials, educational resources, and promotional items to referral partners.
* Coordinate and conduct introductory presentations for prospective referral sources and community partners.
* Maintain ongoing communication with existing referral partners to strengthen relationships and improve referral conversions.

Territory Development (Chicago Market Growth)

* Develop and execute a territory growth plan focused on increasing referrals.
* Analyze referral trends and identify opportunities for market expansion across Chicago and nearby service areas.
* Track competitor activity and provide actionable market intelligence to leadership.
* Identify high-potential and underserved areas within the Chicago region.
* Collaborate with operations and clinical teams to ensure successful admissions and smooth client onboarding.

Marketing & Community Outreach

* Plan and participate in community outreach initiatives that increase visibility and engagement.
* Coordinate and support educational presentations, workshops, and informational sessions for referral partners and healthcare professionals.
* Assist with recruitment outreach as needed to support caregiver growth and staffing needs within the market.
* Maintain a strong presence within local healthcare and senior service networks throughout the territory.

Reporting & Accountability

* Maintain accurate records of outreach activities, referral source visits, presentations, and community event participation.
* Submit weekly outreach reports and referral updates to leadership.
* Monitor referral outcomes and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates and census outcomes.
* Meet established goals for outreach activity, referral generation, and territory development.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or related field preferred.
* Minimum 2–3 years of healthcare marketing, home health/home care marketing, business development, community outreach, or related experience preferred.
* Strong relationship-building, networking, and community engagement skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage territory priorities effectively.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM/tracking systems.
* Reliable transportation and willingness to travel throughout the Chicago service area.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in home health, home care, hospice, senior services, healthcare, or Managed Care Organizations (MCO) marketing.
* Existing professional relationships within Chicago’s healthcare and senior care community preferred.

Performance Expectations

* Maintain weekly outreach activity goals and measurable referral targets.
* Participate in community events and networking opportunities consistently.
* Develop and grow referral source relationships resulting in increased admissions.
* Support achievement of branch census growth and territory performance goals.

Pay: $59,700.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: On the road

jobs.description:
Overview:

The Executive Assistant is a trusted partner to the CEO, responsible for managing the CEO’s time, priorities, communications, and logistics while also owning the day-to-day operation of L5’s Chicago office. This role combines high level executive support with hands-on office management and administrative coordination across the business. The ideal candidate anticipates needs before they arise, brings structure to competing demands, exercises sound judgment with highly confidential information, and takes ownership without needing constant direction. It is a highly cross-functional role, partnering closely with the executive leadership team, human resources, finance, operations, business development, and marketing as well as clients, partners, and board members.

Responsibilities:

**Executive Support**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and gatekeeper for the CEO, managing access and prioritizing requests from internal and external stakeholders.
* Proactively manage a complex, fast-moving calendar, resolving conflicts and protecting time for strategic priorities.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings, including leadership team meetings, client and partner meetings, and board meetings; prepare agendas, briefing materials, and pre-reads, and track follow-up actions to completion.
* Draft, edit, and proofread correspondence, presentations, reports, and other materials on behalf of the CEO with a high standard of quality and professionalism.
* Plan and manage domestic travel, including itineraries, site visits to client facilities, conferences, and related logistics; adjust quickly when plans change.
* Process and reconcile the CEO’s expense reports accurately and on time.
* Handle confidential business, client, financial, and personnel information with the utmost discretion.
* Support special projects and executive initiatives, including research, tracking, and coordination across teams.

**Office Operations**

* Own the office environment, creating a welcoming, organized, and professional workplace for employees, clients, and visitors.
* Manage day-to-day office operations, including supplies, mail and deliveries, and general upkeep.
* Serve as the first point of contact for visitors, vendors, and office-related questions.
* Coordinate with building management, landlords, and vendors to resolve facilities issues.
* Plan and coordinate company meetings, leadership offsites, small client dinners, celebrations, and team-building activities, including vendors, logistics, and setup.

**Administrative & People Support**

* Partner with human resources to support onboarding for new hires in the office, including workspace and equipment readiness, first-week scheduling, and introductions.
* Coordinate interview scheduling for executive and office-based roles across candidates and the hiring team.
* Maintain organized, confidential files and records for the executive office.
* Develop and maintain administrative processes, templates, and tools that improve efficiency and consistency as the company grows.

Qualifications:

* 7+ years of experience supporting a C-level executive, with 2 years of office management responsibility preferred; experience in a fast-growing organization a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
* Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and follow-through, with the ability to juggle competing priorities and shift gears quickly.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a polished, professional presence with executives, clients, and board members.
* Proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information, including financial and personnel data, with discretion and sound judgment.
* Proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented; able to anticipate needs and act independently.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams); ability to learn new systems quickly.
* Flexibility to support occasional needs outside of normal business hours, including some evenings or weekends.
