Momentum Textiles & Wallcovering, a leading supplier of contract textiles & wallcovering, is seeking an Inside Sales Agent in Irvine, CA.

  

The ideal candidate will be highly motivated, possess strong people and communication skills, have a positive attitude, and be self-motivated. If you have the drive and related experience to excel in Contract Textiles & Wallcovering Sales, we encourage you to apply!

  

Our dedicated professionals are the key to our success. In exchange for their hard work, we support our team with an excellent compensation and benefits package, a family friendly work environment and have been voted Best Places to Work for the past four years. Momentum is committed to superior service and operational excellence.

  

POSITION PURPOSE: To provide superior customer service to customers and sales representatives by handling incoming calls, updating customer accounts, answering customer inquiries, entering written and verbal fabric orders, scheduling appointments for sales reps, offering reselect options to customers and verifying orders.

  

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

* Minimum of 2 years of previous customer service experience required.

* Must have excellent customer service skills.

* Ability to multi-task.

* Ability to work under pressure on time sensitive issues.

* Positive, professional, friendly, and customer focused attitude.

* Ability to plan and prioritize workload.

* Must have MS Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint proficiency.

* Must have a desire to work in a fast-paced environment.

* Textile Industry experience is a plus.

  

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND KEY ACTIVITIES:

* Be familiar with the Outside Sales Core Competencies.

* Facilitate the sales process by add-on selling, informational gathering, probing, offering reselects, relationship building with clients.

* Answer incoming calls and complete outbound calls in a timely manner.

* Process verbal and written fabric orders by typing information into the order processing system.

* Monitor reports, providing information to customers, maintaining customer accounts, responding to customer voice mails and e-mails, providing feedback to the Outside Sales department, information sharing capability within CRM database.

* Interact with various departments on a regular basis – Credit, Purchasing, Design, Warehouse, IT.

* Continuously increase product, technical and system knowledge in order to assist internal and external customers.

* Assist outside sales team with special requests.

* Assist customers with problems that arise.

* Observe and obey all company safety procedures and practices.

Live in the Irvine, CA area and work a hybrid schedule of 3 days in the office and 2 days remote

*Momentum is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) for all qualified persons without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, and pregnancy), age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and respected. This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, promotion, training, development, transfer, and discipline, in compliance with federal, state, and local laws*.

new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
Roland DGA is in need of an ambitious and talented Sales Development Representative looking to join a dynamic and fast-paced sales organization. We want someone who is driven, results-oriented, and has a natural instinct for sales to join our team. This person will take pride in maximizing the effectiveness of our marketing efforts and will play a critical role in growing the business. If you have a ton of smarts, are equally as fun, and thrive on teamwork and winning… this is the place for you! This is an entry-level, full-time position based in our corporate office in Irvine, CA, following a hybrid schedule of 3 days in the office and 2 days remote. Spanish fluency is required.

**The Roland DGA Family**  
Roland DGA Corporation serves North and South America as the sales, marketing, distribution and service arm for Roland DG Corporation of Hamamatsu, Japan. Roland DG is a worldwide leader in wide-format inkjet printers for the sign, textile and personalization markets; engravers for awards, giftware, signage and direct part marking; and desktop 3D printers and milling machines for the dental CAD/CAM, product prototyping and medical industries.

Roland DGA is a nine-time winner of the Orange County Register Top Workplace Award. We prioritize our positive culture and a creative, team-oriented environment, and offer an attractive benefits package including continuing education and 401k matching. If you are goal oriented and driven to grow both personally and professionally, then this is the company for you.

**Position Purpose**  
Under the direction of the Sr. Director of Customer Development, the Sales Development Representative (SDR) engages with new and existing sales prospects across North and South America through channels such as telephone, email, and web chat. The SDR generates new sales opportunities for our sales channels and follows up on leads created by Roland DGA through trade shows, advertisements, web forms, and CRM mining.

In addition, the SDR conducts regular outbound campaigns and leverages lead-generation platforms to identify new opportunities. This role collaborates closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product Management teams to maximize prospect engagement, strengthen the sales pipeline, and increase closed-won rates.

**Essential Functions & Basic Duties**

**Lead Management & CRM**

* Manage and document all sales opportunities in a CRM, ensuring accurate tracking and timely updates.
* Handle inbound pre-sales inquiries via phone, email, web chat, and social media to generate qualified opportunities.
* Follow up on dealer-distributed opportunities to confirm prospect engagement, purchase outcomes, or pending status.
* Close out opportunities in a CRM once they have reached the end of their lifecycle.
* Set up new customer accounts and update contact profiles to maintain clean and accurate CRM data.
* Utilize CRM and database-mining platforms to build prospect lists and support outreach initiatives.

**Sales Development & Outreach**

* Manage the Sales Development email queue and respond to inquiries in a timely manner.
* Execute targeted communication campaigns to customers and prospects, promoting sales initiatives, special offers, and equipment updates.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Product Management on lead and opportunity distribution, campaigns, and strategic initiatives.
* Assist with pre-sales email outreach and post-show lead processing to maximize event ROI.

**Relationship Building & Representation**

* Develop and maintain positive relationships with prospects, customers, and dealer partners.
* Participate in industry trade shows and educational events, representing Roland DGA professionally.
* Present sales materials at corporate and dealer training sessions to support product and sales enablement.

**Reporting & Professionalism**

* Generate and deliver Sales and Marketing reports to support business insights.
* Uphold Roland’s highest professional and ethical standards as outlined in the Employee Handbook.

**Performance Measurements**  
**Lead & Opportunity Management**

* Consistently qualify and convert sales leads in a timely and accurate manner.
* Maintain thorough documentation of activities and demonstrate strong product knowledge in all customer interactions.

Customer Engagement

* Drive consistent outbound communication and follow-up with customers and prospects.
* Take full ownership of assigned inquiries, ensuring professional resolution and follow-through.

**Collaboration & Team Contribution**

* Actively support departmental goals and contribute to the achievement of company objectives.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, and Product Management.

**Task Execution & Accountability**

* Complete daily, weekly, monthly, and special assignments within established timelines.
* Demonstrate accuracy, reliability, and attention to detail in all deliverables.

**Professional Standards**

* Receive positive peer feedback during performance reviews as an indicator of teamwork and professionalism.
* Adhere to company policies and guidelines, including attendance, punctuality, and ethical standards as outlined in Roland’s Employee Handbook.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of two years’ experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, or Marketing.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Collaborative team player who builds positive relationships across departments.
* Knowledge of Sales Development processes and systems is a plus.
* Familiarity with wide-format printing, cutting, engraving, and/or 3D milling technologies is a plus.
* Spanish language fluency (spoken and written) is required for this role.

**SALARY RANGE:** $55,000 - $60,000 +

new_jobs.title: Receptionist - Client Experience & Front Office
new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a professional, personable, and highly organized Receptionist to serve as the welcoming face and first point of contact for our firm. This is an important client-facing role that helps shape each client’s first impression and ensures a professional, responsive, and welcoming experience from the moment they contact or visit our office.

As our Receptionist, you will be at the center of our day-to-day front office operations, welcoming clients and guests, answering and directing incoming calls, coordinating communications, and providing essential administrative support to our team.

The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys helping people, communicates with warmth and professionalism, and takes pride in creating an exceptional experience for clients. You should be comfortable managing multiple priorities while remaining organized, attentive, and composed in a fast-paced professional environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the first point of contact for clients, prospective clients, visitors, and callers, creating a warm and professional first impression.
* Answer, screen, and direct incoming calls and respond promptly to general inquiries by phone, email, and in person.
* Maintain a professional, organized, and welcoming environment throughout the reception area, conference rooms, kitchen, and shared office spaces.
* Manage incoming and outgoing mail, packages, deliveries, shipping, parking validations, visitor logs, and front-office security procedures.
* Coordinate calendars, meetings, appointments, and provide general administrative support, including filing, copying, and document preparation.
* Maintain accurate client, appointment, and referral information in Clio Grow and other firm systems.
* Schedule and manage client appointments: track outcomes and follow up with attorneys and legal assistants to ensure records, notes, and required information remain accurate and complete.
* Provide basic technology and platform support, including troubleshooting syncing, connectivity, and user setup issues and coordinating with vendors or IT when necessary.
* Coordinate with building management and outside vendors regarding maintenance, repairs, cleaning, special orders, and other office needs.
* Order, monitor, and maintain office supplies and operational inventory through approved vendors.
* Coordinate Lunch & Learns, All-Hands meetings, Leadership meetings, and other firm events, including scheduling, catering, setup, and cleanup.
* Support new employee onboarding by preparing and distributing company materials, swag, and assisting with access to required platforms.
* Help create a positive workplace experience by coordinating holiday décor, special occasions, flowers, gifts, and employee recognition needs.
* Provide flexible administrative and operational support across the firm, proactively identifying needs and helping ensure the office runs efficiently and clients receive an exceptional experience.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* We are looking for a highly dependable, polished, and service-oriented professional who takes ownership of their work and understands the importance of creating an exceptional client experience.
* Prior experience in a receptionist, front office, client service, administrative, or professional office role required.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally with clients, attorneys, leadership, and staff.
* Strong customer service instincts with a warm, confident, and professional approach to helping clients.
* Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through; able to manage responsibilities without constant supervision.
* Demonstrated ability to multitask, prioritize, and remain composed in a busy professional environment.
* Strong judgment, problem-solving, and resourcefulness when handling unexpected situations or client needs.
* Highly dependable and accountable, with a strong sense of ownership and urgency.
* Comfortable learning and working across multiple software platforms, databases, scheduling tools, and office systems.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and common business productivity applications.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive client information with discretion and professionalism.
* Professional appearance and demeanor appropriate for a client-facing law firm environment.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education, administrative training, or relevant professional experience preferred.

Pay: From $50,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

new_jobs.title: Federal Pro Bono Project Coordinator (Part-Time)
new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Join a nonprofit organization dedicated to improving our community through programs that provide equal access to legal services. The Justice & Diversity Center of The Bar Association of San Francisco (JDC) has an exciting opportunity for a part-time **Federal Pro Bono Project Coordinator** to be part of the team!

**About JDC**

JDC is a non-profit organization which provides free legal services through its staff and volunteers to low-income Bay Area residents. Each year more than 1,600 volunteer attorneys, legal assistants, and law students work with JDC staff to serve nearly 7,500 indigent clients. JDC’s holistic advocacy approach seeks to address the social service and legal needs of clients.

**About the Job**

The Federal Pro Bono Project Coordinator will work with JDC’s Federal Pro Bono Project, reporting to and working with the Supervising Attorney and Senior Staff Attorney. The Federal Pro Bono Project assists self-represented litigants in two ways: (1) staff attorneys at Legal Help Centers in the San Francisco and Oakland federal courthouses provide legal advice and guidance on federal civil cases; and (2) the Project matches litigants with volunteer attorneys to represent them in their cases.

This is a part-time position working 15 hours per week. Working hours are flexible but must be performed during regular business hours, Monday through Friday. The schedule should remain reasonably consistent from week to week. The position is fully remote, but office space is available at JDC’s downtown location should the successful candidate prefer to work some or all of their hours in a more social setting.

As the first point of contact for litigants communicating with the Project, the Coordinator is a critical part of the Project team. The Coordinator’s primary responsibilities are to conduct intakes and screening by phone and email, and to schedule appointments with the Project attorneys when appropriate. The Coordinator uses strong communication and organizational skills to keep the Project’s Legal Help Center legal advice work on track and ensure that litigants eligible for assistance are scheduled in a timely manner. The Coordinator also assists with outreach, database upkeep, development of resources, and improvement of best practices.

The Coordinator works at a fast pace using multiple computer applications, to schedule clients, and communicate with the Project attorneys. Command of Microsoft Office applications is essential for success in the position.

This position is not eligible for benefits and is not an attorney position.

**Education & Experience:**

· Relevant education, training, and experience to perform the essential duties of the position

· Experience in the legal field is helpful but not required

**Skills & Requirements:**

* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications including Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel
* Ability to toggle between communication applications at a fast pace
* Professional verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to interact with clients courteously and with cultural humility
* Efficient self-starter with strong organization and time management skills
* Careful attention to detail
* Demonstrated interest in working with diverse, low-income communities
* Bilingual language skills are a plus

**Why Work For Us**

The Project team offers a small, supportive work environment within a larger organization and the opportunity to collaborate with a progressive work culture and a diverse staff. Additionally, we are a mission and values-based organization.

To find out more about JDC, please visit our website at www.sfbar.org/jdc

**To Apply**

Please submit your resume along with cover letter to https://secure.saashr.com/ta/i.BAS.careers?ApplyToJob=755499013&full\_apply=&jobid=755499013

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

JDC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We conduct all employment-related activities without regard to race, color, sex, religion, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation or any other classification protected by applicable Local, State or Federal employment discrimination laws.

Pay: $31.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Do you now or in the future require sponsorship in the United States?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94102

new_jobs.title: Music School Program Coordinator (Private Lessons & Recitals)
new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Music School Program Coordinator provides administrative and operational support for CSMA’s Music School. The primary responsibility of this position is driving enrollment for both current and prospective students. Fulfillment of this responsibility requires coordinating faculty schedules, breaks, and availability using strong interpersonal communication and collaboration skills.

A secondary responsibility of this role is handling logistics for all Music School recitals. This includes managing event scheduling, ensuring necessary resources and equipment are provided, and attending recitals in person to facilitate the needs of faculty, student performers, and guests.

Reporting to the Music School Director, this position also works in alignment with the Music Classes & Faculty Supervisor to handle faculty needs and logistics. This is a key support role that requires high interpersonal resilience, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to provide professional support to faculty.

**Primary Roles and Responsibilities**

* **Enrollment Coordination:** Actively drive the enrollment process by managing new inquiries, conducting follow-up communication via phone and email, and navigating registration software. The priority in this operational area is to provide the level of follow-through necessary to maximize student enrollment and retention.
* **Faculty Schedules & Support:** Manage faculty teaching schedules, availability, and breaks with high precision. Optimize room schedules, resolve calendar conflicts, and serve as the primary point of contact for assigned faculty.
* **Recital Coordination:** Lead all logistical and administrative operations for student recitals (~40/semester), including communications, resources, and program creation. Responsible for in-person attendance and support at recitals, which requires working some weekends.
* **Student Lifecycle Support:** Coordinate the administrative logistics and success of trial lessons, teacher transfers, make-ups, and withdrawals, collaborating closely with faculty to ensure accurate record-keeping and process completion.
* **Customer Service:** Serve as a front-end representative, welcoming families and delivering exceptional customer service to ensure a positive and personable experience for students and parents.
* **Professional Composure:** Maintain a warm and helpful demeanor while supporting faculty, parents, and students. This role requires the ability to remain objective and professional when navigating interactions with assertive personalities, managing family concerns, or addressing faculty needs under pressure.
* **Student Services Collaboration:** Partner with the Student Services team as a key collaborator to ensure student data is accurate and that families experience a smooth transition from inquiry to active enrollment.
* **Departmental Assistance:** Provide occasional administrative support to cross-program areas and events, including the Music Classes program, as requested.

**Skills, Qualifications & Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in administration, arts management, or related field. A music degree is not required.
* **Working experience:**  2+ years of work experience with customer service, scheduling, or a relevant area. Strong background in music, music education, or instrumental/voice study to evaluate student needs and operate effectively within a music school.
* **Process & Detail Orientation:** Exceptional attention to detail and strong multitasking skills, with a proven ability to navigate complex, multi-step workflows. Proficient in managing information across multiple resources simultaneously, including registration systems, calendars, spreadsheets, and communication channels, to execute operations without error.
* **Event Coordination:** Strong real-time problem-solving skills to ensure seamless recital operations. Adept at assisting faculty and attendees during recitals while working collaboratively with concert hall and facility staff to manage logistics.
* **Independent Operation:** Ability to work independently and solve problems in real time when other administrative personnel are not available. Must remain calm and resourceful to effectively resolve unexpected logistical or client issues without immediate managerial oversight.
* **Professional Maturity & Composure:** Professional maturity, ability to remain calm, composed, and solutions-focused when navigating high-pressure situations, tight deadlines, or challenging interactions.
* **Google Workspace & Technology:** Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Sites, and Sheets), alongside a strong adaptability for quickly mastering new registration software, technology, and collaborative administrative tools..
* **Customer Relations & Sales:** Highly personable, building connections across phone, email, and in-person communications. Pairs a warm, accommodating approach with strong drive and enthusiasm to engage families, prioritize inquiries, and grow student enrollment.

**Schedule & Physical Requirements**

**Schedule**

* Tuesday - Friday (12:00 pm - 8:30 pm) & Saturday (9:00 am - 5:30 pm).
* Occasional weekend availability required to support recitals and special events.

**Physical Requirements**

* Occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
* Frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
* Frequently required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms.

Pay: $28.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 403(b)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**Company Overview**

Promise modernizes how government agencies and utilities support people in financial difficulty. We build technology that makes it simple for residents to receive benefits, engage with assistance programs, set up flexible payment plans, and stay on track—while helping agencies increase efficiency, recover revenue, and deliver services with dignity. ------------------

You will be the person who knows what is actually happening with our accounts: where adoption is strong, where it is stalling, where the political winds are shifting, and where there is room to expand and upsell.

You will work directly with senior stakeholders inside utility companies, and municipal agencies, alongside our internal Product, Sales, Outreach, and Implementation teams. * **Represent Promise in the room.** Run regular business reviews with customer stakeholders. Come prepared. Never walk in cold. Take notes and report out with clear tasks and timelines.
* **Feed the institutional knowledge base.** What you learn in the field belongs to the whole company. Document it and share it so the next person does not have to relearn it.

**What will help you succeed**

* **Strategic and Proactive Hands-on Approach.** You develop strong relationships. You spot trends and issues before the client does and take action, as needed, to remedy them. * **Experience owning account health outcomes** — renewal risk, adoption, or expansion — for a portfolio of large, complex customers.
* **You use data to make an argument, not to fill a slide.** You can pull adoption and throughput numbers, figure out what is actually driving them, and turn that into a specific plan with a named owner and a date.

new_jobs.description:
**About the role:**

You will own our inventory from the shelf to the purchase order: knowing what we have, where it is, and what we need next. You will also be the first stop for purchase requests, researching products and suppliers so the team buys the right item at a fair price.

This role suits someone who likes putting things in order and keeping them that way, and who enjoys digging into specs, prices and lead times before recommending a purchase.

**Inventory management and organization**

* Keep accurate counts of parts, materials, tools and supplies in our inventory system.
* Receive incoming shipments, check them against the purchase order, and report shortages or damage.
* Label, bin and shelve items so anyone on the team can find them without asking.
* Design and maintain the storage layout, including bin locations and naming conventions.
* Run regular cycle counts and a full physical count on a set schedule, and resolve discrepancies.
* Set and monitor minimum stock levels, and flag items before they run out.
* Track tools and equipment that are checked out, and follow up on returns.
* Identify obsolete, excess or damaged stock and recommend what to do with it.
* Keep storage areas clean, safe and orderly.

**Purchase requests and research**

* Take in purchase requests from the team and clarify what is needed, by when, and why.
* Research options: compare specifications, price, availability, lead time, shipping cost and supplier reliability.
* Request and compare quotes from multiple vendors.
* Present a short recommendation with the options considered, so the approver can decide quickly.
* Create purchase orders once approved, and track them through delivery.
* Follow up with suppliers on late, incorrect or incomplete orders, and handle returns.
* Maintain vendor records, including contacts, pricing, terms and past performance.
* Look for savings through alternate sources, bulk pricing or substitutions that meet the same need.
* Match receipts to purchase orders so accounting can pay vendor bills without delay.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 2+ years in inventory control, purchasing, warehouse, stockroom or a similar role.
* Strong organizational habits and attention to detail; your counts are right.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets and with learning inventory or ERP software.
* Able to research unfamiliar products and summarize the options clearly in writing.
* Clear, professional communication with coworkers and suppliers.
* Able to work independently and follow through without reminders.
* Able to lift up to [50] lb and spend part of the day on your feet.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Odoo or another ERP system.
* Experience buying industrial, mechanical or electrical parts and reading spec sheets or drawings.
* Experience negotiating with vendors or arranging freight.
* Forklift certification.
* Barcode or label system setup experience.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager (Manufactuing Technology)
new_jobs.description:
**About Teeptrak**
------------------

Teeptrak is a worldwide leader in providing manufacturing monitoring solutions, specializing in turnkey digital solutions that enable factories to optimize performance in a cost-effective, innovative way. As we expand our footprint in the U.S., we are growing our commercial team and are looking for an Account Manager to turn qualified opportunities into lasting customer relationships.

**About the Role**
------------------

As an Account Manager at Teeptrak, you will own the meetings that move prospects to customers. Our Business Development Representatives book qualified meetings, and you take it from there: you run discovery and follow-up meetings, coordinate demos with our Sales Engineers, build proposals, and close new business. Once a customer is live, you stay their main commercial contact and grow the account across lines, plants and sites.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable leading a conversation with a plant manager, an operations director or a CFO, and who can keep a full calendar of meetings organized and moving forward.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Meeting Ownership: Run discovery, follow-up and decision meetings with prospects booked by the BDR team, both virtually and on-site at customer facilities.
* Discovery & Qualification: Understand each plant's production challenges, current tools and goals, and identify the stakeholders involved in the buying decision.
* Sales Cycle Management: Move opportunities from first meeting through pilot, proposal, negotiation and signature.
* Demo Coordination: Work with Sales Engineers to prepare and deliver product demos and pilots tailored to each customer's operations.
* Proposals & Negotiation: Build proposals and quotes, present pricing, and negotiate terms with customers.
* Account Growth: Own a portfolio of customer accounts after signature, hold regular business reviews, and identify expansion opportunities to new lines, plants and Teeptrak products.
* Customer Relationships: Act as the main commercial contact for your accounts and work with customer success and support to keep customers satisfied.
* CRM Management: Keep meetings, notes, pipeline stages and forecasts accurate and up to date in our CRM.
* BDR Collaboration: Give feedback to the BDR team on meeting quality and target accounts to improve the pipeline.
* Market Feedback: Share customer insights with the sales, marketing and product teams to shape Teeptrak's U.S. strategy.

  
**Requirements**

**Who You Are**
---------------

* A confident meeting leader who can guide a conversation, ask the right questions and agree on clear next steps.
* Comfortable speaking with operators, engineers and executive leadership.
* Highly organized, able to manage a full calendar and many opportunities at once.
* Able to understand technical products and explain their business value in a clear way.
* Self-motivated, results-driven and coachable.
* A team player who works well with BDRs, Sales Engineers and customer success.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 2+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management or account executive roles.
* A track record of running meetings, managing a pipeline and closing deals.
* Strong verbal, written and presentation skills.
* Experience with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, Odoo, HubSpot).
* Willingness to travel to customer facilities.

**Bonus If You Have**
---------------------

* Experience selling to manufacturing or industrial companies.
* Familiarity with OEE, MES or production monitoring systems.
* Experience in SaaS or industrial technology sales.
* Experience managing multi-site or enterprise accounts.

  
**Benefits**

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base salary with commission and performance-based incentives
* Growth potential as we expand in the U.S.
* Direct impact on a fast-growing U.S. business
* 401(k)
* Unlimited PTO
* Paid sick days and holidays
* Hybrid work schedule
* Health, dental and vision insurance

**Teeptrak is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
---------------------------------------------

At Teeptrak, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable work environment where all individuals can thrive. We believe that diversity strengthens our team and contributes to our success. We are dedicated to offering all candidates a fair, accessible and inclusive experience throughout the hiring process, regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Teeptrak, we encourage you to embrace your authentic self and share what makes you unique.

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**About Teeptrak**  
Teeptrak is a worldwide leader in providing manufacturing monitoring solutions, specializing in turnkey digital solutions that enable factories to optimize performance in a cost-effective, innovative way. As we expand our footprint into the U.S., we are looking to scale our team and are seeking an enthusiastic and results-driven Sales Development Representative to help drive our growth in the U.S. market.

**Position Overview**  
As a Sales Development Representative (BDR) at Teeptrak, you’ll play a key role in spearheading our U.S. market expansion. You will be responsible for generating high-quality leads, qualifying prospects, and setting up meetings with potential clients. Your work will lay the foundation for successful sales engagements, introducing Teeptrak’s innovative solutions to manufacturing companies, and contributing to sustainable long-term growth in the U.S.

**Job Description**  
Responsibilities:

* Lead Generation: Proactively generate high-quality leads through outreach via phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels to build a strong sales pipeline.
* Pipeline Development: Research and qualify prospects, identify key decision-makers, and nurture relationships to build a sustainable pipeline for the sales team.
* Sales Collaboration: Work closely with the sales and marketing teams to schedule meetings, demos, and follow-ups with qualified prospects, contributing to Teeptrak’s overall growth strategy in the U.S.
* Strategic Contribution: Provide valuable insights to shape and implement sales strategies that align with Teeptrak’s long-term vision for success in the U.S. market.
* CRM Management: Maintain accurate records of interactions, progress, and key performance indicators (KPIs) in our CRM system, ensuring data integrity for ongoing strategic planning.
* Value Proposition Demonstration: Effectively communicate Teeptrak’s unique value proposition to potential clients, addressing questions, overcoming objections, and building trust.
* Team Growth & Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to the team’s growth by sharing insights, best practices, and continuously enhancing your understanding of Teeptrak’s solutions.
* Adaptability: Demonstrate flexibility to adjust quickly to evolving market conditions, responsibilities, and priorities as Teeptrak’s presence grows in the U.S.
* Product Knowledge: Continuously enhance your understanding of Teeptrak’s products and the manufacturing industry to better position our solutions and provide more value to prospects.

  
**Requirements**

**Required Experience**  
Education:

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.

Work Experience:

* At least 1+ years of experience in sales or as a Sales Development Representative (SDR), preferably in a B2B environment, and a demonstrated interest in the manufacturing or technology sectors.

Skills:

* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage prospects and clearly articulate Teeptrak’s value proposition.
* Technical Learning: Ability to quickly understand and communicate technical concepts and products in a relatable way to prospects.
* Adaptability: Thrive in a fast-paced environment with the ability to manage multiple priorities and shifting responsibilities.
* Resilience: Strong passion for sales and personal growth, with the resilience to overcome challenges and push through obstacles.
* Self-Motivation: Highly organized and self-driven, with excellent time management skills.
* Independence & Teamwork: Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team setting.
* Coachable: Willingness to learn, grow, and accept constructive feedback to improve performance.
* Problem-Solving: Creative in overcoming challenges and identifying solutions that benefit both the company and the customer.

**Preferred Job Requirements:**

* Previous experience in the manufacturing or technology sector.
* Familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce).
* Experience with outreach and sales tools (e.g., LinkedIn Sales Navigator, outreach platforms).

  
**Benefits**

**What We Offer:**

At TeepTrak, we believe in working hard AND enjoying life! That’s why we offer awesome benefits like:

* Competitive salary with performance-based incentives and commission opportunities
* Growth potential as we expand in the U.S.
* Collaborative environment where your contributions directly impact our success
* 401(k) for your future
* Unlimited PTO—take time when you need it, no limits!
* Paid sick days & holidays—because everyone deserves a break
* Hybrid work schedule—some days in the office, others from home
* Health, dental, and vision insurance to keep you covered

Join us and be part of a team where your growth and success matter!

Teeptrak is an Equal Opportunity Employer  
At Teeptrak, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable work environment where all individuals can thrive. We believe that diversity strengthens our team and contributes to our success. We are dedicated to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience throughout the hiring process, regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Teeptrak, we encourage you to embrace your authentic self and share what makes you unique.

new_jobs.description:
**Aiphone Corporation is looking for a Regional Sales Representative in Milwaukee, WI or Chicago, IL. We offer a competitive base salary and benefits package. This position is eligible for commission and quarterly bonuses.**

### **About the Position**

Responsible for assisting in the sales of the company’s products throughout a defined geographical region, industry, or product line.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** include the following. Other duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

* Achieves quarterly and annual goals assigned by Director of Sales, including but not limited to, regional sales quotas, new product sales, customer training, and strategic account management.
* Assists in managing the company’s relationships with all local, regional, and national accounts.
* Assists distributors and dealers with the development of new business opportunities.
* Helps develop short- and long-range sales objectives, plans strategies for attainment, and develops sales performance standards for measuring progress.

**Additional Responsibilities** include the following.

* Reports progress towards assigned goals to Director of Sales.
* Conducts training classes, both technical and sales, for various accounts.
* Compiles and analyzes sales data.
* Uses company resources and self-training techniques to learn company sales and marketing goals and strategies; product information including technical and application; effective use of account management and presentation tools.
* Maintains and updates customer database.

**Inter-relationship** Relationship of position with internal, lateral, and external groups.

Interacts with co-workers as a team member. Works closely with marketing team, other field sales managers, department managers, and senior/executive management. Works closely with sales representatives. May work closely with existing and prospective customer accounts.

**Physical Demands:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. The employee is regularly required to sit for long periods of time; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; balance; bend and reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. Occasionally required to climb ladders, stand, stoop, kneel, squat, crouch, or crawl. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**Work Environment:**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. For the most part, ambient room temperatures, lighting and traditional office equipment as found in a typical office environment. Position requires working out of a home office and includes travel up to 50% to various company, industry, and customer related events on an international, national, regional, or local basis.

**GENEROUS BENEFITS:**

* Base salary with guaranteed bonus and performance bonus potential
* Health benefits
* Generous 401K match
* Additional benefits

### **Position requirements**

*The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**Education and Related Experience:**

* Typically requires an associate degree or equivalent and knowledge of, and/or experience in the sales of product within the industry, or product segment.
* Requires a minimum 2 years of sales management experience.
* Experience in business-to-business, channel and consumer marketing preferred.

**REQUIRED COMPETENCIES:** To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of:

* Excellent written, oral communication and presentation skills required. Must have strong problem-solving skills and communicate persuasively.
* Proficient in Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and SharePoint) with knowledge of standard CRM Database package and other software programs used within the company.
* Steady paced, able to work consistently with many distractions. Must be able to work within a team and independently. Must be able to maintain an organized schedule with competing priorities, executing plans within scheduled deadlines.
* Good analytical ability with a high degree of accuracy.
* Acts in ethical and professional manner at all times with colleagues, customers, and vendors, representing the highest standards of Aiphone behavior.
* Fosters an inclusive workplace where diversity and individual differences are valued and leveraged to achieve the vision and mission of the organization.
* Is open to change and new information; adapts behavior or work methods in response to new information, changing conditions, or unexpected obstacles; effectively deals with ambiguity.
